symbols.name: createCapabilityHost
symbols.purpose: Creates an isolated host owning feature permission, activation state and disposable handles. Register activation callbacks, grant permission explicitly and call enable to start. `options` defaults to `{}`; omitted flags deny every capability. Resource dependencies belong to the graph entry rather than this independent-feature gate.
symbols.core:
context: Required application context, which may explicitly be `undefined`; there is no default, cloning or prescribed field shape. Activation callbacks receive the original value. In the first case, the caller owns the `tenant` string field.
Caller-owned ICapabilityHost; dispose it when finished. Invalid options throw tagged native errors before construction completes.
flags: Copied complete name-to-boolean mapping; only own enumerable data properties exactly `true` grant permission. Getters and inherited properties do not grant permission; later input mutation has no effect.
`undefined`: every capability is denied until explicitly permitted by a flag; granting permission does not activate it.
onError: Receives (name, error) for activation or release failure; name comes from registration and error is original. No return is consumed; synchronous or async reporter failure reaches the shared utils host exception queue without changing business state.
The default is undefined, meaning that no error callback is configured. Omission therefore sends no callback notification, but failures remain recorded. Use host.error(name) to read a recorded failure even when no callback was supplied.
Set it when activation and cleanup failures need monitoring. The callback receives the registered name and original error. Omitting it keeps failures available through host.error(name) but sends no callback.
parameters: context: Context
options: ICapabilityHostOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: ICapabilityHost<Context>

guidance.id: 用一份新配置替换全部开关-未列出的功能自动释放
guidance.heading: 用一份新配置替换全部开关，未列出的功能自动释放

blocks.text: 应用启动后打开了搜索、客服和导出三项功能。配置中心推送了一份新配置：保留搜索，关闭客服，导出没有出现在新配置里。
常见做法拿到新配置后，要自己和旧配置逐项比较，找出哪些功能被关掉、哪些被删掉，再逐个调用各自的停止函数；漏掉一项，它就继续运行。停止的顺序通常是代码里写的顺序，后启动、可能依赖先启动功能的那个，反而可能先被留下或后被关闭。
`setFlags(flags)` 用一整份新配置原子替换全部开关。没有出现在新配置里的名字一律视为关闭；被关闭的功能按实际启动完成的相反顺序释放。
options.flags 初始允许三项功能。三项按搜索、客服、导出的顺序启动。新配置只列出 search: true 和 chat: false，export 没有列出。
输出：

blocks.code:
启动 search
启动 chat
启动 export
停止 export
停止 chat
search=on export=gated chat=gated
停止 search

blocks.text: 依次输出三次启动，然后是 `停止 export`、`停止 chat`、`search=on export=gated chat=gated`，最后 `dispose()` 输出 `停止 search`。导出没有出现在新配置里，和明确关闭的客服一样被释放；释放顺序与启动完成顺序相反。
新配置是整份替换，不是合并：想保留的功能必须写进新配置。替换只负责关闭和释放，新允许的功能仍要调用 `enable(name)` 才会启动。多租户应各建一个宿主，各自持有自己的开关快照。

members.name: activate
members.description: Activates this capability. Async activation supports loading enhancements such as persistence on demand. Dynamic imports keep the disabled capability's chunk out of the initial bundle. Receives the host's original context reference and must return a handle with a callable dispose method. A rejected start or invalid handle becomes a failed enable result; a late valid handle is released, not adopted.

state: Reads current capability lifecycle state; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.

setFlags: Atomically replaces all flags; omitted names lose any earlier permission.

members.name: register
members.signature: register<Handle extends ICapabilityHandle>(definition: ICapabilityDefinition<Context, Handle>): void;
members.description: Captures a name and activation function without activating. Duplicate names, malformed recipes, disposed hosts, and synchronous lifecycle reentry fail with the corresponding host code.

members.name: names
members.description: Fresh registration-order name array; it is a snapshot, not the mutable registry.

members.name: state
members.description: Reads current lifecycle state; an unknown name throws NOT_REGISTERED, even after disposal.

members.name: handle
members.signature: handle<Handle extends ICapabilityHandle>(name: string): Handle | undefined;
members.description: Returns the enabled handle or undefined; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.

members.name: error
members.description: Returns the retained activation or release failure, or undefined. Starting a new attempt or deactivating clears the prior diagnostic; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.

members.name: setFlag
members.description: Updates one flag. Disabling synchronously invalidates pending activation and releases the handle. Enabling does not activate. A name may be configured before it is registered; the setter does not wait for asynchronous cleanup.

members.name: setFlags
members.description: Atomically replaces all flags. Missing capabilities are denied, so removed keys cannot retain an earlier true value. An unreadable snapshot gates every entry before INVALID_OPTION is thrown. Accessor flags are not evaluated, and this setter does not await cleanup.

members.name: enable
members.description: Activates the capability and returns its structured activation outcome. Concurrent in-flight calls share the exact Promise and one activation. A denied flag resolves gated without activation; an already enabled entry resolves enabled. Activation failures resolve failed, while unknown names, disposed hosts, and transition reentry reject.

members.name: disable
members.description: Synchronously invalidates activation and releases the current handle, then waits for this entry's in-flight activation and cleanup, including late results. Resolves true only if the entry was on; pending activation cancellation returns false. Cleanup failures are reported.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Makes the host terminal and releases handles in reverse activation-completion order, then waits for every in-flight activation and release. Cleanup failures are reported without stopping other releases. Later calls fail with HOST_TRANSITIONING until the first completion Promise settles; after completion they return that original Promise by identity.

members.name: disposed
members.description: Becomes true synchronously when final disposal begins, before pending cleanup settles.

symbols.name: IDynamicCapabilityGraph
symbols.purpose: Serialized dependency graph owning ordering and exact binding custody; composition callbacks own physical resources.
symbols.core:
nodes: Current registered IDs in definition insertion order; removed definitions disappear.
state: Graph container lifecycle, separate from each node and its binding availability.
generation: Monotonic graph mutation generation used to distinguish committed lifecycle epochs.
register: Snapshots and serializes admission of a dynamic definition and optional composition binding; ready graphs reconcile newly available required providers.
register.node: Application-created ID, kind, dependencies and start recipe. The graph hands definitions to startBatch; it does not invoke start itself.
register.binding: Optional application-owned binding associated with this exact generation, for example a composition host. Omitted means no binding.
Promise of IGraphMutationResult with affected IDs, topologyChanged and generation. Invalid state or admission timeout rejects with a graph error.
remove: Removes a definition through reject or required-dependent cascade policy; cleanup precedes binding custody release.
remove.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
remove.options: Optional policy: cascade by default, or reject while required dependents remain.
suspend: Suspends a node and required dependent frontier while retaining definitions for explicit recovery.
suspend.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
suspend.options: Optional cascade policy by default; reject refuses a node with required dependents.
resume: Restores availability of the retained suspended provider instance without rerunning startBatch, then reconciles affected required dependents; a non-suspended target rejects GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED.
resume.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
dependentsOf: Reads direct present consumers split by required and optional edge kind without starting or mutating them.
dependentsOf.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphDependents with required and optional ID lists; unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
replace: Replaces an existing node generation and binding, releases old custody and restarts affected instances; unchanged edges retain schedule metadata.
replace.node: Replacement definition using the application-assigned ID of an existing registration.
replace.binding: Application-owned next-generation binding; omitted replaces it with undefined.
replace.options: Optional restartDependents defaults true. With false, onReplaced may rebind direct required dependents; absence or callback failure falls back to restarting their closure.
ready: Queues reconciliation and batch startup for currently startable definitions; missing required providers remain blocked rather than starting.
Promise completing this serialized readiness operation; batch startup failure rejects GRAPH_START_FAILED with original cause. This is not the static graph canonical readiness Promise.
nodeState: Creates a current diagnostic including binding generation, retained value, errors and cached schedule rank.
nodeState.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphNodeDiagnostic; unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
getBinding: Reads the retained composition binding without acquiring a lease or requiring node readiness.
getBinding.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
Original binding or undefined for an unknown node or omitted binding. Use acquireBinding when observation must delay release.
acquireBinding: Retains one exact ready binding generation. Pair with the returned lease release() before awaiting graph cleanup.
acquireBinding.id: The application-assigned ID supplied through graph.register(node, binding).
IGraphBindingLease with original value and idempotent release; absent, unready or undefined bindings throw GRAPH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.
dispose: Immediately closes admission and queues final physical cleanup and binding release; terminal cleanup clears definitions. Final disposal waits behind admitted predecessors in the same FIFO without mutationAdmissionMs timeout.
One shared disposal Promise. Composition releaseBatch must honor the lease fence; releaseBinding failures are reported, while releaseBatch failures reject disposal.

members.name: nodes
members.description: Frozen registration-order ID snapshot; final disposal removes all definitions.

members.name: state
members.description: Container state; ready does not imply every node has its required providers.

members.name: generation
members.description: Mutation counter, initially zero; readiness alone does not advance it.

members.name: register
members.description: Queues admission of a new definition and optional binding, then starts its satisfiable required-consumer frontier. Missing providers leave nodes blocked; a start failure rejects while retaining the admitted definition and its diagnostic for later reconciliation.

members.name: remove
members.description: Removes the target definition and binding after cleanup. Default cascade releases required consumers but retains their definitions as blocked; reject refuses any required consumers.

members.name: suspend
members.description: Withholds the target and blocks required consumers without releasing their instances or bindings. Defaults to cascade; reject refuses a target with required consumers.

members.name: resume
members.description: Restores a suspended target and satisfiable retained consumers, starting only missing instances. Other unavailable required providers keep consumers blocked; a nonsuspended target rejects with GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED.

members.name: dependentsOf
members.description: Returns frozen direct required/optional consumer lists; an absent ID throws GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.

members.name: replace
members.signature: replace<T>(node: IDynamicGraphNodeDefinition<T>, binding?: TBinding, options?: IGraphReplaceOptions<TBinding>): Promise<IGraphMutationResult>;
members.description: Queues replacement of a present definition and binding, preserving its registration ordinal. Defaults to restarting required consumers; false restartDependents attempts onReplaced with restart fallback. Same-edge replacement preserves canonical rank and level.

members.name: ready
members.description: Queues startup of currently satisfiable nodes and sets container ready; blocked nodes may remain.

members.name: nodeState
members.description: Returns a fresh, unfrozen diagnostic projection with original value/binding references; unknown IDs throw.

members.name: getBinding
members.description: Reads a binding without checking node availability or acquiring a lease; absent IDs return undefined.

members.name: acquireBinding
members.description: Returns a frozen lease for a ready non-undefined binding; unavailable or sealed generations reject.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Immediately closes admission, then queues final cleanup behind accepted work without an admission timeout. Repeated calls share the exact Promise. Definitions are cleared and state becomes terminal even if releaseBatch rejects; the composition owner must honor lease fences.

sections.content: Composition-owned callbacks for batch startup, lease-aware release and contained reporting.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
report: Receives original contained startup, release and late failure as error; return is ignored and own throws/rejections are contained.
Omitted: no external failure reporter is called.
Set it when contained startup, cleanup or late failures must reach monitoring. It receives the original error and does not replace graph results. Omission sends no external callback.
mutationAdmissionMs: Maximum queued wait before an ordinary mutation starts; finite nonnegative milliseconds only. Final dispose is exempt and waits for preceding admitted work in the same FIFO.
Omitted: the mutation queue has no admission deadline.
startBatch: Required callback receives topologically ordered IGraphStartEntry entries, each with id, binding and definition. Return one instance per entry in the same order, synchronously or by thenable. The owner must construct and roll back physical resources; throw/rejection becomes GRAPH_START_FAILED.
Always supply the physical startup owner. Return one instance for each entry, in the same order, and roll back partial resources if startup fails. There is no default; the graph does not execute definition.start for you.
releaseBatch: Required callback receives provider-first IGraphReleaseEntry entries and a Promise fence that resolves when sealed generation leases drain. Await the fence before physical teardown, release consumers first, and return void or completion thenable. Failure rejects the operation.
Always supply physical cleanup. Wait for fence, then release entries in reverse order so consumers stop before providers. There is no default, and a rejected cleanup rejects the operation.
releaseBinding: Receives an exact IGraphBindingReleaseEntry after successful instance cleanup for removal, replacement or disposal. Return void or completion thenable; failures are reported without replacing the primary result.
Omitted: graph relinquishes bindings without a composition release callback.
Set it when a composition binding owns something beyond the graph instance. It runs after instance cleanup on removal, replacement and final disposal. Omit it when relinquishing the binding needs no callback; failures go to report without stopping other bindings.

symbols.name: buildCapabilityTopology
symbols.purpose: Snapshots a static node set and builds deterministic provider adjacency, schedule levels and order. Validate all required providers, dense ordinals and cycles before exposing the immutable projection.
symbols.core:
nodes: Required caller-authored array; every field is required with no default. `nodes[].id` is a unique nonempty string, `nodes[].ordinal` is a unique safe integer collectively covering 0 through nodeCount minus one, and `nodes[].dependencies` is an array (`[]` for none). Each dependency has a nonempty string `provider` and boolean `required`, with no duplicate provider within a node. `required: true` requires the provider to exist; `false` permits absence, while present optional edges still affect levels and cycles. Caller input is copied, not reordered.
onUnknownProvider: Required synchronous `(nodeId, provider) => never`, with no default. Both string arguments come from the caller’s node and missing required-provider edge. Must throw a caller-owned error, which propagates unchanged.
onCycle: Required synchronous `(path) => never`, with no default. The frozen string array is a closed cycle (first ID repeated last), rotated to its smallest registration ordinal. Must throw a caller-owned error.
onInvalid: Required synchronous `(reason, nodeId?, failure?) => never`, with no default. blocks.text: 本包委托当前宿主的原生 `AbortController`，返回真实 host instance（结构上与 DOM/Node 的 `AbortSignal` 兼容，可互相传递）：

无构造参数，也不接受 custom factory。实际对象由当前 realm 的 host-owned `globalThis.AbortController` 构造；lifecycle 不返回 facade、Proxy 或自建 EventTarget。宿主 constructor 缺失、getter throw、不可构造、构造失败或结果不满足最小 controller/signal shape时，抛保留原始 cause 的 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`。
需要注意的行为：

items: `abort()` 与 `abort(undefined)` 使用宿主默认 reason，通常是原生 `DOMException`（name 为 `AbortError`），而不是 `undefined`。
non-`undefined` explicit reason保持 `===` identity；把 structural parent signal 的 `undefined` reason转发给native child时，同样规范化为宿主 `AbortError`。
重复 `abort()` 幂等，不覆盖第一次固化的 reason。
外部 listener throw走宿主 EventTarget error channel；`try/catch controller.abort()` 不能同步捕获它，lifecycle也不再提供 `ABORT_LISTENER_FAILED`。

Lifecycle 自己登记的 parent/cancellation callback 经过 module-private observed-subscription：处理 already-aborted、registration-time abort、post-registration recheck和幂等remove，并把自身 callback/read/cleanup failure交给对应 operation的collect/report边界。它不代理、枚举或捕获同一 signal 上的外部 listener。

blocks.text: 如果业务需要旧式“listener错误由调用 abort 的栈聚合抛出”，应使用业务自己拥有的回调编排器；不要包裹或 monkey-patch native `AbortSignal`。

declaredConfiguration.name: parentSignal
declaredConfiguration.description: When this aborts, the currently-active generation's `signal` aborts too.

declaredConfiguration.name: onSuperseded
declaredConfiguration.description: Diagnostic channel fired from `adopt()` whenever `token` is no longer current — before the release attempt, regardless of whether it succeeds. The value is a `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED`-tagged error used purely as a `(source, code)`-bearing carrier; this is explicitly _not_ a failure signal, just an observability hook for callers that want to notice the race without treating it as an error.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Uses a runtime-neutral scheduler for `begin({ timeoutMs })` timing. Defaults to `systemScheduler`.

declaredConfiguration.name: report
declaredConfiguration.description: Last-boundary reporter for failures that have no caller to receive them: an `adopt()` release failure when that call passes no `onReleaseError`, and timer/parent cleanup failures raised by an asynchronous `begin({ timeoutMs })` timeout. Its own throws and rejections are contained. Without it those failures are dropped.

type IGenerationControllerOptions = {
  readonly parentSignal?: IAbortSignal
  readonly onSuperseded?: (info: ILifecycleError) => void
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
}

type IGenerationToken = object

type IGenerationRequest = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly token: IGenerationToken
  readonly signal: IAbortSignal
}

type IGenerationController = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly disposed: boolean
  begin(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number }): IGenerationRequest
  isCurrent(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  complete(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  supersede(reason?: unknown): void
  adopt<T>(
    token: IGenerationToken,
    value: T,
    release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>,
    onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void
  ): boolean
  dispose(reason?: unknown): void
}

blocks.text: 代数 + 每代一个 `AbortSignal`，新一代自动使旧一代失效：
边界行为：

items: `begin(options?)`：使当前活跃代（若存在）立即失效（触发其 `signal` 中止），`generation` 自增，返回新的 `{ generation, token, signal }`。`options.timeoutMs?` 非法（非有限/负数）抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；超过该毫秒数后当前代的 `signal` 自动中止。控制器已 `dispose()` 后调用抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`。
`isCurrent(token)`：`token` 是否仍是当前代；`dispose()` 之后恒为 `false`。
`supersede(reason?)`：作废当前代（其 `signal` 中止）但控制器本身仍可用，之后 `begin()` 仍能开新代；对已 `dispose()` 的控制器调用是空操作。

`complete(token)`：只释放匹配的当前代，返回 true 并使 token 不再 current；先清 timer、再移除 parent listener，保持 signal 未中止。stale/disposed token 返回 false，不影响当前代。cleanup 失败仍以原 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED` 保留原 cause，失败后 token 已作废；后续 `begin()` 仍可用。真正取消继续使用 `supersede`/parent/timeout/dispose，保持原 signal 与 reason。

`adopt(token, value, release, onReleaseError?)`：`token` 仍是当前代时返回 `true`，`value` 留给调用方；否则调用 `release(value)` 回收并返回 `false`——`release` 本身抛出/reject 只会经 `onReleaseError` 上报，绝不反过来污染"当前是哪一代"这一状态（不会抛出、不会重新计入错误策略）。若提供了 `onSuperseded`，在过期路径上先额外触发一次携带 `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED` 码的诊断信息（非失败信号）。
`dispose(reason?)`：终态；之后 `begin()` 恒抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`，`isCurrent()` 恒 `false`。
`parentSignal` 中止时，当前活跃代同步中止（清理 timer、移除 parent listener、abort 自身 controller）；清理过程中任一步失败会聚合为 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`。

The value is a `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED`-tagged error used purely as a `(source, code)`-bearing carrier; this is explicitly _not_ a failure signal, just an observability hook for callers that want to notice the race without treating it as an error.

configuration.name: scheduler
configuration.description: 调度器契约 `IScheduler`/`IScheduledTask` 与默认实现 `systemScheduler`（`performance.now()` 单调时钟）由 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 导出；`createManualScheduler`/`IManualScheduler` 由 `@migaia/utils/testing` 导出，本包不再导出或再导出它们。本包保留注入准入层：`createMutationQueue`、`createGenerationController`、`boundedWait` 与 dispose transaction 未注入 scheduler 时，使用 `resolveScheduler(systemScheduler)` 的快照，所以非法延迟仍以 lifecycle `INVALID_OPTION`（`detail.field: 'delayMs'`）拒绝；直接调用 utils `systemScheduler.schedule()` 时同样输入得到的是 utils `INVALID_ARGUMENT`。

configuration.name: report
configuration.description: Generation controller 的 `report?: (error: unknown) => void` 负责没有调用方接收的失败：adopt 未传 onReleaseError 时的过期资源释放错误，以及异步 timeout 的 timer/parent-listener 清理错误。reporter 自身的 throw/rejection 交 utils 共享宿主异常队列；省略时这些诊断不外发。
configuration.descriptionEn: Last-boundary reporter for failures that have no caller to receive them: an `adopt()` release failure when that call passes no `onReleaseError`, and timer/parent cleanup failures raised by an asynchronous `begin({ timeoutMs })` timeout. Its own throws and rejections are contained. Without it those failures are dropped.

symbols.name: IGenerationController
symbols.purpose: Single-active-generation controller returned by `createGenerationController()`; stale results never regain ownership by matching a numeric counter alone.
symbols.core:
generation: Monotonically advanced counter for begins, supersedes and first disposal; it is diagnostic, while token identity decides currency.
disposed: Whether disposal has permanently closed this controller; a disposed controller cannot begin another generation.
begin: Invalidates the previous token and aborts its signal before creating a new request. Pair with `adopt()` or `isCurrent()` when accepting the eventual result.
begin.options: Optional object with `timeoutMs`: finite nonnegative per-generation milliseconds. Omitted timeout means no timer; a supplied invalid value throws `INVALID_OPTION` before replacing the old generation.
An `IGenerationRequest` with a fresh token, captured generation and native signal. A disposed controller throws `GENERATION_DISPOSED`; cancellation cleanup may throw `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`.
isCurrent: Checks exact active token identity and controller liveness without changing state or refreshing the timeout.
isCurrent.token: Token returned by this controller’s `begin()` request, not a caller-created object or generation number.
True only while this exact token remains active and the controller is not disposed.
complete: Invalidates a matching token and cleans its timer and parent subscription without aborting the completed request’s signal.
complete.token: Exact token returned by the request created through this controller’s `begin()`.
True after completing the active token, false for stale/disposed tokens. Cleanup failure may throw after invalidation.
supersede: Invalidates and aborts the active generation without permanently disposing the controller; the caller may begin fresh work later.
supersede.reason: Optional caller-issued cancellation value forwarded unchanged to the active signal; omitted uses native abort semantics.
The current token is invalid and its owned timer/listener are released; cleanup failure can throw. A disposed controller does nothing.
adopt: Accepts a result only for the current token. Pair with `begin()`; stale values are released immediately, with asynchronous release rejection observed independently of newer work.
adopt.token: Token returned in the original `begin()` request that produced this result.
adopt.value: Result produced by caller-owned asynchronous work, passed unchanged to the stale-release callback.
adopt.release: Caller-authored `(value) => void | PromiseLike<void>` that releases only a stale result. The value is this adoption input; throws/rejections go to the selected release-error reporter.
adopt.onReleaseError: Optional synchronous `(error) => void` receiving the release failure; omitted uses the controller reporter. Return ignored; throws and rejections are contained.
True when the caller keeps the current result, false when stale release was attempted; false does not wait for asynchronous release.
dispose: Permanently prevents new generations and invalidates the active token before releasing cancellation resources; repeated calls do nothing.
dispose.reason: Optional caller-issued abort reason forwarded to the active request; omitted follows native abort semantics.
The controller is disposed and its active request aborted; cancellation cleanup failure can throw after state convergence.

examples:
import {
  createGenerationController,
  type IGenerationController,
  type IGenerationControllerOptions,
  type IGenerationRequest,
  type IGenerationToken
} from '@migaia/lifecycle'

function createGenerationController(options?: IGenerationControllerOptions): IGenerationController

type IGenerationControllerOptions = {
  readonly parentSignal?: IAbortSignal
  readonly onSuperseded?: (info: ILifecycleError) => void
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
}

type IGenerationToken = object

type IGenerationRequest = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly token: IGenerationToken
  readonly signal: IAbortSignal
}

type IGenerationController = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly disposed: boolean
  begin(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number }): IGenerationRequest
  isCurrent(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  complete(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  supersede(reason?: unknown): void
  adopt<T>(
    token: IGenerationToken,
    value: T,
    release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>,
    onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void
  ): boolean
  dispose(reason?: unknown): void
}

members.name: begin
members.description: Starts a new generation, superseding whatever was active. Optionally auto-aborts after `timeoutMs`.

members.name: complete
members.description: Releases the matching current token's timer and parent subscription without aborting its signal. Returns false for stale/disposed tokens; cleanup failures retain cancellation codes and causes after invalidating the token.

members.name: supersede
members.description: Invalidates the current generation without disposing the controller — a later `begin()` still works.

members.name: adopt
members.signature: adopt<T>(token: IGenerationToken, value: T, release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>, onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void): boolean;
members.description: Adopts `value` under `token`'s generation. Returns `true` and keeps `value` with the caller if that generation is still current. Otherwise releases `value` via `release` and returns `false` — a release failure is funneled to `onReleaseError` (or the controller `report` when omitted) and never mutates controller state, so it cannot poison whichever generation is current now.

symbols.name: IGenerationControllerOptions
symbols.purpose: Caller configuration for parent cancellation, generation timeout scheduling and release diagnostics.
symbols.core:
parentSignal: An `IAbortSignal` from the parent owner; cancellation invalidates the active token. Non-undefined reasons retain identity; undefined is normalized to the host-native AbortError. Parent cleanup failures go to `report` once.
Omitted: generations do not subscribe to an external parent.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
onSuperseded: Synchronous `(info) => void` diagnostic called before releasing a stale adopted result. The supplied `ILifecycleError` has `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED`; its return is ignored, synchronous throws and asynchronous rejections go to the existing `report` boundary. Reporter failures reach the shared utils host exception queue without changing adoption.
onSuperseded.info: Diagnostic `ILifecycleError` created by the stale adoption operation.
No value is consumed; accidental asynchronous rejection is observed through `report`.
Omitted: discarded adoption produces no superseded diagnostic callback.
Set it to notice a late result that cannot be adopted. It runs before releasing that stale value. Omission sends no superseded diagnostic; it does not affect which token is current.
report: Final synchronous diagnostic sink for stale-result release failures without a per-call reporter and asynchronous timeout cleanup failures. Receives `error`; throws and rejections are contained.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: these last-boundary failures have no reporting sink.
Set it to observe stale-result release failures or asynchronous generation cleanup failures without a per-call receiver. Omission drops those last-boundary diagnostics; adoption still returns its own result.

members.name: whenZeroOnce

members.name: seal
members.description: Blocks further `retain()` calls for `key`. Idempotent.

members.name: forget
members.description: Returns whether this call removed stored idle state; absent or already-pruned keys return false.

symbols.purpose: Creates an asynchronous resource owner with explicit release descriptors, descending release priority and reverse-registration tie order. Closing stops admission; disposal releases resources and always converges to terminal state.
symbols.core:
An `ILifecycleScope`; repeated external disposal calls return the same promise. Invalid scheduler or a required missing reporter throws `INVALID_OPTION`.
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
Keep default throw to propagate release failures. Choose collect to inspect a returned list, report to deliver every failure to a required reporter, or firstError to throw the first and report later ones. Every item still receives its release attempt.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.

blocks.code:
function createLifecycleScope(options?: ILifecycleScopeOptions): ILifecycleScope

type ILifecycleScopeOptions = {
  readonly errorPolicy?: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError' // 默认 'throw'
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
  readonly deadlineAt?: number
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
}

type ILifecycleScope = ILifecycleOwner & {
  readonly lifecycle: 'open' | 'closing' | 'terminal'
  own<T>(resource: T, descriptor: IReleaseDescriptor): T
  release(resource: unknown): boolean
  close(): void
  dispose(): Promise<readonly ICollectedError[]>
  [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> // await using；丢弃收集到的错误结果
}

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

guidance.id: 方法调用-descriptor-与-options-的读取时机
guidance.heading: 方法调用、descriptor 与 options 的读取时机

blocks.text: `createLifecycleScope`、`createSyncLifecycleScope`、`createProvisionalScope` 和 `createMutationQueue` 返回的对象，方法都定义在原型上，必须通过对象调用（`scope.own(...)`、`queue.enqueue(...)`）。把方法解构出来单独调用（`const { own } = scope`）不受支持。
`own()` 校验 descriptor 时会保存一份快照，释放时使用的就是这份快照：注册之后再修改 descriptor 对象，或 getter 之后返回不同的值，都不会影响释放。provisional scope 在 `commitTo(parent)` 时仍把原 descriptor 交给 `parent.own()`，由父 scope 自己校验和快照。
options（`errorPolicy`、`report`、`deadlineAt`、`scheduler`、`onAdmissionDiagnostic` 等）只在创建时读取一次，之后不会再读。
释放回调收到的 `context.signal` 在第一次读取时才创建（已经处于 aborted 状态，reason 为 `SCOPE_CLOSED`）；provisional scope 没有传 `parentSignal` 时，它的 `signal` 也是第一次读取时才创建。不读取 signal 的释放回调不会产生 AbortController。

symbols.name: ILifecycleScope
symbols.purpose: Asynchronous resource owner returned by `createLifecycleScope()`, with distinct admission-close and release-completion phases.
symbols.core:
own: Registers one resource and an explicit release descriptor while the owner is open. The same resource identity may be registered more than once; no resource method is discovered automatically.
own.resource: Value allocated by the caller; keep this exact identity for a later unregister operation.
own.descriptor: Caller-authored `IReleaseDescriptor` declaring required `force` and optional graceful/custom release callbacks. Invalid fields fail registration.
The exact `resource` unchanged; closed and terminal owners throw `SCOPE_CLOSED` or `SCOPE_TERMINAL`.
release: Removes the earliest active registration of a resource without calling its descriptor. Use after independently releasing it; repeated calls can remove separate registrations of the same value.
release.resource: The exact resource identity previously passed to this scope’s `own()`.
`true` if one registration was removed; `false` if none remains.
lifecycle: Current survival state from `LifecycleState`; closing forbids new work and terminal is irreversible.
close: Stops ownership registration synchronously and aborts the scope’s closing signal with `SCOPE_CLOSED`; no resource release callback is invoked here.
Admission is closed; call `dispose()` to perform resource release.
dispose: Closes admission and releases the stable resource snapshot by descending priority with reverse-registration ties. External repeated calls share one promise; synchronous self-disposal throws `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`.
A promise of collected errors for `collect`, empty for other successful policies. Throw/first-error policies reject after release; the scope still reaches terminal.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Supports `await using` by awaiting the same asynchronous disposal and discarding its collected-error return value.
A `Promise<void>` settling with disposal; thrown-policy failures still reject.
symbols.advanced: Group resources whose release may await I/O and report all failures only after every release attempt.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

members.name: release
members.description: Unregisters a resource without releasing it — the caller has already released it independently.

members.name: close
members.description: Synchronous, idempotent, never calls user code.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Always asynchronous — there is no synchronous `dispose()` on this type. Resolves to the collected errors for the `collect` policy (empty for the other three, which throw/report internally instead). Concurrent external calls reuse the same published Promise even while release is in flight. Only a synchronous call from an active disposer callback is rejected as reentrant, preventing that callback from self-awaiting the Promise it is currently helping to settle.

members.name: [Symbol.asyncDispose]
members.description: Awaits scope release for `await using`, discarding the collected-error result.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
Keep default throw to propagate release failures. Choose collect to inspect a returned list, report to deliver every failure to a required reporter, or firstError to throw the first and report later ones. Every item still receives its release attempt.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
Supply a synchronous receiver when cleanup failures must reach monitoring. It is required with report or firstError policies; omission otherwise provides no diagnostic sink. Return no value; reporter failures are contained.
deadlineAt: Absolute finite time in the selected scheduler clock. Every item sees the same `deadlineAt`; it caps graceful waiting only, so forced release can continue beyond it.
Omitted: no shared deadline; an individual descriptor may still set its own graceful budget.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.

function createLifecycleScope(options?: ILifecycleScopeOptions): ILifecycleScope

type ILifecycleScopeOptions = {
  readonly errorPolicy?: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError' // 默认 'throw'
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
  readonly deadlineAt?: number
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
}

type ILifecycleScope = ILifecycleOwner & {
  readonly lifecycle: 'open' | 'closing' | 'terminal'
  own<T>(resource: T, descriptor: IReleaseDescriptor): T
  release(resource: unknown): boolean
  close(): void
  dispose(): Promise<readonly ICollectedError[]>
  [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> // await using；丢弃收集到的错误结果
}

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

symbols.name: PluginHost
symbols.purpose: Base class of a plugin-capable host. A new host only manages plugins (install, remove, disable, replace, configure, dispose) and pipeline stages; every domain capability arrives through plugins. Subclasses provide the domain core plugins receive by overriding `createPluginDomainCore()`.
symbols.core:
options: Optional IPluginHostOptions; mutation and pipeline-drain budgets default to 5000 ms each. Identity, pipeline and diagnostics configure this Host only.
A new empty PluginHost instance; install plugins to obtain domain capabilities and await dispose() when its lifetime ends. Invalid configuration throws before the instance is published.
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Pipeline mode fixed at construction: `sync`, `async`, `generator` or `async-generator`.
revision: Counter of committed installation, removal, replacement, configuration, enablement, stage-registration and terminal changes. Composition owners compare revision to detect stale snapshots; it remains readable after disposal.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
runPipelineSync: Runs original synchronous stages from the same canonical lane. Any visible async stage throws ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY before effects. Available on sync/async owner handles or as a protected subclass entry; generator hosts keep runPipeline.
runPipelineSync.value: Input value.
runPipelineSync.done: Terminal returning TResult.
TResult | undefined; halted stages return undefined. Empty lanes preserve the exact terminal value.
runPipelineAsync: Runs async forms of the same stage registrations, including lifted sync stages. Waits for the real terminal Promise and onion cleanup; uses the existing host cancellation and leases.
runPipelineAsync.value: Input value.
runPipelineAsync.done: Terminal returning Promise<TResult>.
Promise<TResult | undefined>. A halted stage resolves undefined; an empty lane returns the original terminal Promise by identity.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Omitted; identity.name defaults to DEFAULT and the runtime issues a unique id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
execution: Optional execution budgets, each defaulting to 5000 ms: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: Optional pipeline record. mode is sync, async, generator or async-generator; defaults to sync and is fixed after construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
pipeline.mode: Pipeline mode; invalid values throw `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`.
`sync`.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
Set it to observe diagnostic throwing or rejecting without changing host operations. Omission forwards failure to globalThis.reportError when available. Return no value from this final receiver.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.

use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
runPipelineSync: Runs original synchronous stages from the same canonical lane. Any visible async stage throws ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY before effects. Available on sync/async owner handles or as a protected subclass entry; generator hosts keep runPipeline.
runPipelineSync.value: Input value.
runPipelineSync.done: Terminal returning TResult.
TResult | undefined; halted stages return undefined. Empty lanes preserve the exact terminal value.
runPipelineAsync: Runs async forms of the same stage registrations, including lifted sync stages. Waits for the real terminal Promise and onion cleanup; uses the existing host cancellation and leases.
runPipelineAsync.value: Input value.
runPipelineAsync.done: Terminal returning Promise<TResult>.
Promise<TResult | undefined>. A halted stage resolves undefined; an empty lane returns the original terminal Promise by identity.
dispose: Closes permanently: stops new changes, drains pipelines and releases plugins with dependents first. The completion Promise is published before callbacks or abort listeners run; concurrent or reentrant disposal shares it, so cleanup middleware runs once. The lifecycle abort reason and later admission failure can be distinct instances with the same source/code.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult`: `cleanupErrors` lists cleanup failures; `cleanupComplete: false` means some cleanup is still running, observe `physicalCompletion`.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Adds an asynchronous processing function. Call await next(value) to wait for later functions, then perform any work that must happen after them. This is often called onion-style execution because functions wrap later work. The host must use async mode; another mode makes registration throw PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Adds a synchronous generator: a function that produces values step by step with yield. Use it when processing is written in that form. The host accepts it in generator mode and adapts it in async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Adds an asynchronous generator, which can wait for asynchronous work and produce values with yield. Use it for processing written as async function*. The host must use async-generator mode; other modes reject registration with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Omitted; identity.name defaults to DEFAULT and the runtime issues a unique id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
execution: Optional execution budgets, each defaulting to 5000 ms: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: Optional pipeline record. mode is sync, async, generator or async-generator; defaults to sync and is fixed after construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
pipeline.mode: Pipeline mode; invalid values throw `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`.
`sync`.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
Set it to observe diagnostic throwing or rejecting without changing host operations. Omission forwards failure to globalThis.reportError when available. Return no value from this final receiver.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
A library (logger, store, RPC peer) extends `PluginHost` so users add optional plugins instead of more constructor options.
An application composes cache, auth and telemetry as plugins that share capabilities through Features and are removed with full cleanup.
There are only one or two fixed extension points that never change at runtime: plain options or function composition are simpler.

guidance.heading: 创建 Host 与全部选项

blocks.text: 类入口可重写 `createPluginDomainCore()`，每次安装创建一份领域 core。默认返回空对象。领域 core 必须是普通对象、可枚举 data property，不能覆盖 `config`、`onDispose`、`pipeline` 或四个 `use*Pipeline` core 保留成员；无效表面以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。
函数入口 `defineHost(options)` 返回冻结的 canonical handle。它提供与类入口相同的功能，并把类上的 protected `useSync`、`runPipeline` 暴露给持有 handle 的 owner。选项 `host` 可选，形状与类构造选项一致；其余字段如下：

rows: 可选；省略返回空对象。request 的 `pluginName`、从零开始的批内 `batchIndex`、`batch` 身份均由宿主提供
可选；省略保留原 PluginHostError；默认结构化结果路径不调用此钩子，也不逐项转换 cleanupErrors
可选；自定义释放中间件，回调自行调用 `next()` 纳入内核清理；重复内核释放仍复用原 Promise
可选；默认无领域公开成员，第四类型参数默认空表面
可选；真实 `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)` 组成的固定命名映射；defineHost 在顶层传入。

blocks.text: `surface` 支持对象或工厂。对象形式的自有描述符在获取 Runtime 之前读取一次，访问器保持动态，所有 canonical Host 键（包括 identity、use、unUse）仍为保留键。工厂形式 `surface: (native) => ({ ... })` 在创建最终 handle 时执行一次，收到冻结的原生 `use`、`unUse`，可组合并替换这两个方法；其他 canonical Host 键仍不能替换。领域方法、Host 身份、共享出口和 fluent 管线方法属于同一个冻结 handle，组合方应通过 surface 提供方法，不能复制返回的 handle。surface 读取或工厂失败保持原错，经 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 边界分类。旧对象写法和三类型参数调用仍有效。
类构造 `options` 可选，defineHost 的 `host` 同样可选；全部省略时使用下表默认值：

rows: 可读名称可选，宿主另分配唯一 id
本次变更 hook 的执行预算；`false` 无期限
pipeline 租约排空预算；`false` 等真实排空
接收诊断及被包含的原始失败对象
诊断器自身 throw/reject 的终端出口
默认只诊断；数值表示排队拒绝阈值；false 关闭相关计时与诊断
仅未配置排队拒绝阈值时生效；false 关闭诊断计时器
单个普通释放步骤的等待预算；false 无期限

blocks.text: 所有时间数值须有限、非负；非法选项、非函数回调或不满足 scheduler 协议的对象以 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。直接导入 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的消费项目需直接安装 utils。

guidance.id: 命名管道-类型-权限与生命周期
guidance.heading: 命名管道：类型、权限与生命周期

blocks.text: 在函数入口的顶层 `pipelines`，或类构造选项的 `pipelines`，声明一个固定的“名字 → `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)`”映射。每条管道独立推断载荷和 mode；名字是非空的自有可枚举字符串键，值必须来自真实 `pipelineSpec`，不能用结构相同的普通对象替代。说明对象被冻结；Host 的声明在构造时固定；插件也可在 `definePlugin({ pipelines })` 声明自己的组，随安装创建、失败回滚、卸载按原预算排空后删除。插件不能覆盖 Host 的同名管道，冲突以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝。

rows: `'sync'`、`'async'`、`'generator'`、`'async-generator'`；决定 stage 及 run 返回类型。
`'single'` 或 `'multiple'`；直接采用 middleware-pipeline 的四模式继续及失败规则。
`'install'` 按分配顺序，`'reverse'` 按其逆序；同一插件在所有管道共享原排序 slot。

blocks.text: 持有函数 handle 的 owner 调用 `host.pipeline(name).use(stage)` 或 `.run(value, done)`；类 owner 使用 protected `pipeline(name)`。安装中的插件和 Feature core 只有 `use(stage)`、`through(name)` 登记权，没有 run。两种命名登记都返回带幂等 `remove()` 的句柄；移除影响后续运行，已取得的快照仍由原生命周期排空。

插件和它的 Feature 用原名访问 Host 管道、用短名访问自己的管道，并通过既有 Feature 依赖用 `插件名.管道名` 访问提供方的组。无依赖关系的插件不能访问别人的组。`IPluginHostCoreFor<typeof host>` 适合仅使用 Host 声明的 core；声明插件自己的管道时，保留 install 参数的推导，避免 Host-only 注解遮掉自己的短名。未知或不可见名字同步抛 `PIPELINE_UNKNOWN`；诊断包含查询的插件或 Feature、请求名和可见的 Host、本插件、依赖插件范围。

sync、generator 的命名 run 返回 `TResult | undefined`；async、async-generator 返回 `Promise<Awaited<TResult> | undefined>`。短路返回 undefined，每次到达末端的遍历各调用一次 done。multiple 不返回结果数组；需要每次结果时，在 done 中明确收集。multiple 模式下，stage 可以处理经 next 的 then/await 观察到的分支失败；未观察的失败仍由 runner 拒绝，多个原错按启动顺序保留在 `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED` 中。generator 用 throw 把失败交回 yield；sync 遍历全部登记值后汇总错误。

所有管道在同一 Host 事务中提交；每条管道在同一可见 stage 修订内复用编译快照，reverse 也只在编译时处理。没有可见 stage 时直接调用终点，不取快照或 lease。有 stage 时，所有管道复用同一套登记、排序和 quiescence/lease owner。安装失败回滚、unUse、replace、禁用和挂起在一次提交中作用于该插件的全部管道；已有运行持有原快照和分管道的代际 lease，drain 等待这些实际运行，清理和排空预算仍由既有生命周期配置控制。任何管道执行期间，owner 向任一管道注册 stage 都会抛 `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`。

Host 未声明 pipelines 时，其命名轴默认为 `Record<never, never>`；已知插件定义仍能推出其限定名。Host 和插件都没有命名组时，不分配额外的命名 runner、lane 或 lease key。原 `TValue`、`pipeline.mode`、四个 use*Pipeline、runPipeline/runPipelineSync/runPipelineAsync、pipelineMode 都只操作默认管道，原有显式泛型调用不变。默认管道使用内部 symbol，不占用任何字符串名字。显式填写 defineHost 泛型并同时声明命名管道时，要在第五个泛型参数传 `typeof pipelines`；省略它会保留空轴，pipeline(name) 只接受 never。

非法 map、名字、spec、order 以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 在构造时拒绝，不返回 handle；mode 非法仍是 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。next 非法的外层码为 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`，cause 保留 middleware-pipeline 的 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION`。spec 配置 getter 抛错时也以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 保留原 cause。

PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `plugin.host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

symbols.name: RpcContractErrorCode
symbols.purpose: The pure Contract package owns semantic codes for field admission, handshake selection and wire-error graph validation.
symbols.core:
callbackFailed: `CALLBACK_FAILED`: a warning, scheduler or cleanup callback failed without prior semantic identity. Native mutable errors retain identity, type and stack; other values stay on cause. Safe wire summaries do not expose callback text.
invalidDescriptor: `INVALID_DESCRIPTOR`: invalid stable component identity/version; correct local configuration.
invalidEnvelope: `INVALID_ENVELOPE`: reject the invalid semantic message without executing it.
invalidStream: `INVALID_STREAM`: reject the invalid event, sequence or value budget and terminate only its stream.
invalidFrame: `INVALID_FRAME`: discard malformed physical or empty batch framing.
frameLimitExceeded: `FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: complete physical or retained reassembly bytes exceeded a bound.
frameAssemblyExpired: `FRAME_ASSEMBLY_EXPIRED`: not all ordered fragments arrived before the assembly timer.
invalidWireError: `INVALID_WIRE_ERROR`: reject the malformed bounded serialized error tree.
handshakeInvalid: `HANDSHAKE_INVALID`: malformed encoding, JSON or first-channel negotiation fields.
handshakeIncompatible: `HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE`: peer protocol, version or mandatory runtime baseline is incompatible.
handshakeRejected: `HANDSHAKE_REJECTED`: the remote rejected negotiation; inspect the retained remote cause.
extensionNegotiationFailed: A required extension is unavailable or received extension traffic was not negotiated. R6 / BC2 rejects it before application execution; configure compatible extensions.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

symbols.name: RpcCoreErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Stable semantic failure codes owned by the runtime-neutral Core execution layer.
symbols.core:
hostTransportMissing: Exactly one genuine transport is required before opening.
hostNamespaceDuplicate: R3 / BC1 rejects duplicate transport namespaces before acquisition; choose distinct names.
featureCombinationConflict: R8 / A8 rejects two same-kind call features on one plugin; keep one complete instance.
hostPluginInvalid: A copied or fabricated object lacks registered SDK identity.
hostPeerNameDuplicate: A same-name peer is responsive, or its one probe is already pending; reject the newcomer.
callbackFailed: CALLBACK_FAILED: a construction or diagnostic callback failed; native mutable errors retain type, stack and identity, foreign semantic identities stay unchanged, and other values remain on cause.
providerGenerationMismatch: PROVIDER_GENERATION_MISMATCH: accepted caller/provider generation no longer matches the task; select the actual binding again.
forwardLoop: FORWARD_LOOP: signed route revisits this or the selected next Host; choose another route.
forwardHopLimit: FORWARD_HOP_LIMIT: three forwarding nodes were already visited; use a direct channel or shorter route.
capabilityUnsupported: CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED: actual peer agreement does not support the requested runtime mode or capability.
invalidConfig: INVALID_CONFIG: factory, component, transport or transform configuration is invalid; inspect detail and correct local inputs.
probeFailed: PROBE_FAILED: a diagnostic emit/describe/redact callback failed; business execution remains isolated.
providerDuplicated: PROVIDER_DUPLICATED: provide registered a method that already has an owner; change the method or combine providers.
protocolInvalid: PROTOCOL_INVALID: codec/protocol/envelope behavior or correlated control is invalid; inspect original cause.
contractInvalid: CONTRACT_INVALID: method correlation, direction or contract identity fields violate the actual request contract.
payloadInvalid: PAYLOAD_INVALID: data, physical batch encoding or error projection violates its selected codec boundary.
providerNotFound: PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: the receiving endpoint has no registered provider for the requested method.
internal: INTERNAL: provider threw unexpectedly; original error stays in local diagnostics while the peer receives a redacted failure.
targetUnknown: TARGET_UNKNOWN: target or receiver is unresolved, inactive or outside the original selected binding.
endpointDisposed: ENDPOINT_DISPOSED: an operation used a disposed endpoint; construct a new owner instead.
cancelled: CANCELLED: actual caller AbortSignal cancelled the local send; remote effects may already have occurred.
deadlineExceeded: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: the local operation deadline expired; treat this transmission attempt as failed.
contextExpired: PROVIDER_CONTEXT_EXPIRED: success or failed was called after the original provider lifetime ended; no wire effect is produced.
transport: TRANSPORT: actual physical send or terminal channel failed; preserve original transport evidence before choosing recovery. The code alone never proves nonexecution; retry requires independent evidence or idempotency/outcome reconciliation.
authenticationFailed: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: signing, verification, encryption, decryption or original replay binding failed; details stay local.
schemaInvalid: SCHEMA_INVALID: params/result parse rejected the method data; inspect normalized issues and original cause.
capabilityConflict: CAPABILITY_CONFLICT: selected middleware/features publish conflicting keys or an ambiguous runtime instance.
overloaded: OVERLOADED: execution/replay/discovery/chunk capacity refused new work; inspect its independent reason channel.
streamResultUnknown: STREAM_RESULT_UNKNOWN: transport may have sent a stream frame before rejecting; open a new stream without replaying items.
chunkInvalid: CHUNK_INVALID: physical fragment grammar is invalid; hooks observe it and the frame is not replayed.
propertyReadFailed: PROPERTY_READ_FAILED: a getter/proxy failed without a valid synchronous reporter, or that reporter threw.
idempotencyResultUnavailable: IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE: business already ran but result was not retained; resolve outcome before another attempt.
stringConversionFailed: STRING_CONVERSION_FAILED: conversion or its required synchronous reporter failed; preserve original cause.
