members.name: hostTransportMissing
members.description: Host creation requires one registered transport plugin. Add a transport before retrying.

members.name: hostNamespaceDuplicate
members.description: Duplicate transport namespaces are rejected before acquisition; choose distinct names.

members.name: featureCombinationConflict
members.description: Two same-kind call features on one plugin are rejected; keep one complete instance.

members.name: hostPluginInvalid
members.description: Host creation received an object without SDK registration identity. Use the define tools.

members.name: hostPeerNameDuplicate
members.description: An incoming peer name is held by a responsive session, or another admission is probing it. * Choose a different name or close the current session.

members.name: callbackFailed
members.description: A cold Probe listener, middleware installation callback, or diagnostic reporter throws. The * original remains reachable; callers repair the callback rather than retrying side effects.

members.name: providerGenerationMismatch
members.description: The selected authenticated provider/caller generation no longer matches this task; select * again.

members.name: forwardLoop
members.description: A signed route already contains this Host or the selected next Host. Forwarding rejects before * admission and sending; callers must choose a route that does not revisit a Host.

members.name: forwardHopLimit
members.description: Three forwarding nodes have already been visited. Forwarding rejects a fourth before admission * and sending; callers may establish a direct connect/listen channel instead.

members.name: capabilityUnsupported
members.description: A Runtime API operation requires a mode or capability absent from the actual peer agreement. * Choose a supported method/mode rather than retrying the same operation.

members.name: invalidConfig
members.description: A factory, middleware, or transport descriptor or configuration field is invalid. Replay * protection also rejects encrypt-only configuration, unavailable entropy, and exhausted * counters. * * This code identifies argument and configuration failures. The caller corrects the configuration * using `detail` before retrying.

members.name: probeFailed
members.description: A probe emit, describe or redact callback, or a native observation disposer, fails. The * installed probe retains the original cause and isolates diagnostic failure from business * execution; callers should repair or disable the diagnostic sink or its cleanup callback.

members.name: providerDuplicated
members.description: `provide()` registers the same method twice. * * A provider does not replace another provider with the same name. The caller combines the * implementations or changes the name.

members.name: protocolInvalid
members.description: A protocol codec, scheme, or envelope is invalid, the caller cannot reconstruct a response * error, or a provider receives an invalid abort payload. This is the base code for * `RpcProtocolError`. * * The caller checks that the protocol configuration matches the peer scheme. If the payload is * already sent or cancellation has taken effect, inspect the peer rather than retrying the same * message.

members.name: contractInvalid
members.description: Contract fields, direction, or request/response correlation are invalid. This is the base code * for `RpcContractError`. * * The caller checks `version`, `identifier`, sender/target direction, or `taskId`/method * correlation.

members.name: payloadInvalid
members.description: A codec payload violates its input rules, or sender-side error serialization degrades a read or * data projection. This is the base code for `RpcSerializationError`. Physical batch * shape/encoding failures preserve the contract cause; malformed semantic members are reported * individually without discarding valid siblings. * * The caller checks the data, codec, or thrown value. Do not retry the same payload if it is * already sent or cancellation has taken effect.

members.name: providerNotFound
members.description: The provider executor cannot find a provider for the target method (`Provider not found`). * * The caller checks whether `provide()` registers the method. Do not retry the failed lookup. * This is the wire code for an inbound provider lookup failure.

members.name: internal
members.description: A provider throws an unhandled exception. This is the standard code for an `INTERNAL` response. * * Only local hooks receive the redacted original exception. The peer receives `RpcRemoteError` * with code `INTERNAL`.

members.name: targetUnknown
members.description: A target or receiver is unresolved, inactive, or outside the current binding. * * The caller checks whether `targetId` is registered or discovered, or whether `receiverSelector` * returns an unknown receiver.

members.name: endpointDisposed
members.description: An endpoint operation runs after disposal (`RpcLifecycleError`). * * The caller creates a new endpoint instead of reusing the closed instance.

members.name: keepaliveQuotaExceeded
members.description: A keepalive call admitted during Session closing exceeds its in-flight prepared-message quota. * Captured metadata, manifests and native sidecars count before optional feature overhead. The * caller reduces the payload or waits for existing work to settle; final close is uncharged.

members.name: cancelled
members.description: The caller's `AbortSignal` cancels a local send (`RpcAbortError`). * * The caller handles this cooperative cancellation separately from remote failures.

members.name: deadlineExceeded
members.description: A local deadline expires (`RpcTimeoutError`). * * The caller checks target reachability and the timeout duration. Treat the request failure as * the result of this transmission attempt.

members.name: contextExpired
members.description: `ctx.success()` or `ctx.failed()` runs after the provider task ends. * * The expired result produces no wire effects. The caller keeps response logic within the * provider's synchronous or awaited lifetime.

members.name: transport
members.description: A transport send fails, a terminal event occurs, or the transport closes (`RpcTransportError`). * * The code alone does not establish whether a send already executed. Retry only with independent * evidence that it did not execute, or use the existing idempotency/outcome reconciliation.

members.name: authenticationFailed
members.description: A per-frame authentication transform fails during encryption, signing, verification, or * decryption (`RpcAuthenticationError`). Replay protection rejects missing/invalid binding, * duplicate counters and untrusted physical sessions. * * The caller checks key and algorithm configuration. Failure details are not sent back to the * peer.

members.name: schemaInvalid
members.description: Method parameters or results violate the contract schema (`RpcSchemaValidationError`). * * The caller corrects the data using `data.issues` rather than retrying the same invalid data.

members.name: capabilityConflict
members.description: A capability is published twice, or a frozen capability registry receives another write. Also * rejects folded Feature method collisions and ambiguous runtime instances. * * The caller checks middleware for duplicate declarations of reserved capabilities. This is a * configuration error.

members.name: overloaded
members.description: A local capacity limit rejects new work in provider admission, the replay ledger, discovery * waiters, outbound IDs, or chunks. * * The caller reduces concurrency, shortens TTL, or increases capacity. This signals backpressure * rather than a logic error.

members.name: streamResultUnknown
members.description: A stream frame may have been sent before its transport rejected; the caller must open a fresh * stream and never replay delivered values.

members.name: chunkInvalid
members.description: A chunk frame has an invalid format. This is the base code for `RpcChunkError`. * * The caller checks chunk configuration (`chunkSize` ≥ 4) and the peer implementation. An invalid * frame only invokes hooks and is not retried.

members.name: propertyReadFailed
members.description: A getter or Proxy throws during `safeRead` without a synchronous reporter, or the reporter * itself throws. The caller repairs the input or supplies a synchronous `report` at a boundary * that owns a diagnostic sink.

members.name: idempotencyResultUnavailable
members.description: A keyed call already executed but its result was not retained for replay. The caller must * resolve the outcome before issuing another non-idempotent attempt.

members.name: stringConversionFailed
members.description: A string conversion throws without a synchronous reporter, or its reporter throws (cleanup ). * The caller must repair the input or provide a synchronous diagnostic sink.

hostTransportMissing: Exactly one genuine transport is required before opening.
hostNamespaceDuplicate: R3 / BC1 rejects duplicate transport namespaces before acquisition; choose distinct names.
featureCombinationConflict: R8 / A8 rejects two same-kind call features on one plugin; keep one complete instance.
hostPluginInvalid: A copied or fabricated object lacks registered SDK identity.
hostPeerNameDuplicate: A same-name peer is responsive, or its one probe is already pending; reject the newcomer.
callbackFailed: CALLBACK_FAILED: a construction or diagnostic callback failed; native mutable errors retain type, stack and identity, foreign semantic identities stay unchanged, and other values remain on cause.
providerGenerationMismatch: PROVIDER_GENERATION_MISMATCH: accepted caller/provider generation no longer matches the task; select the actual binding again.
forwardLoop: FORWARD_LOOP: signed route revisits this or the selected next Host; choose another route.
forwardHopLimit: FORWARD_HOP_LIMIT: three forwarding nodes were already visited; use a direct channel or shorter route.
capabilityUnsupported: CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED: actual peer agreement does not support the requested runtime mode or capability.
invalidConfig: INVALID_CONFIG: factory, component, transport or transform configuration is invalid; inspect detail and correct local inputs.
probeFailed: PROBE_FAILED: a diagnostic emit/describe/redact callback failed; business execution remains isolated.
providerDuplicated: PROVIDER_DUPLICATED: provide registered a method that already has an owner; change the method or combine providers.
protocolInvalid: PROTOCOL_INVALID: codec/protocol/envelope behavior or correlated control is invalid; inspect original cause.
contractInvalid: CONTRACT_INVALID: method correlation, direction or contract identity fields violate the actual request contract.
payloadInvalid: PAYLOAD_INVALID: data, physical batch encoding or error projection violates its selected codec boundary.
providerNotFound: PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: the receiving endpoint has no registered provider for the requested method.
internal: INTERNAL: provider threw unexpectedly; original error stays in local diagnostics while the peer receives a redacted failure.
targetUnknown: TARGET_UNKNOWN: target or receiver is unresolved, inactive or outside the original selected binding.
endpointDisposed: ENDPOINT_DISPOSED: an operation used a disposed endpoint; construct a new owner instead.
cancelled: CANCELLED: actual caller AbortSignal cancelled the local send; remote effects may already have occurred.
deadlineExceeded: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: the local operation deadline expired; treat this transmission attempt as failed.
contextExpired: PROVIDER_CONTEXT_EXPIRED: success or failed was called after the original provider lifetime ended; no wire effect is produced.
transport: TRANSPORT: actual physical send or terminal channel failed; preserve original transport evidence before choosing recovery. The code alone never proves nonexecution; retry requires independent evidence or idempotency/outcome reconciliation.
authenticationFailed: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: signing, verification, encryption, decryption or original replay binding failed; details stay local.
schemaInvalid: SCHEMA_INVALID: params/result parse rejected the method data; inspect normalized issues and original cause.
capabilityConflict: CAPABILITY_CONFLICT: selected middleware/features publish conflicting keys or an ambiguous runtime instance.
overloaded: OVERLOADED: execution/replay/discovery/chunk capacity refused new work; inspect its independent reason channel.
streamResultUnknown: STREAM_RESULT_UNKNOWN: transport may have sent a stream frame before rejecting; open a new stream without replaying items.
chunkInvalid: CHUNK_INVALID: physical fragment grammar is invalid; hooks observe it and the frame is not replayed.
propertyReadFailed: PROPERTY_READ_FAILED: a getter/proxy failed without a valid synchronous reporter, or that reporter threw.
idempotencyResultUnavailable: IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE: business already ran but result was not retained; resolve outcome before another attempt.
stringConversionFailed: STRING_CONVERSION_FAILED: conversion or its required synchronous reporter failed; preserve original cause.

liquidated: A liquidated registration cannot restart; the caller must create a new registration.

encrypt: Encrypt the prepared nonce/counter binding before signing; input and output must match encodedType and decrypt reverses this operation.
Encryption is disabled when encrypt is omitted; enabling it requires decrypt and both sign and verify.
Use the representation consumed by the actual paired cryptographic transforms; identity transforms do not demonstrate authentication.
decrypt: After inbound signature verification, reverse `encrypt` before envelope admission; a throw rejects the envelope.
Decryption is disabled when decrypt is omitted; encrypt must also be absent.
sign: Sign the exact protected representation with its nonce/counter binding; return the representation consumed by verify.
Signing is disabled when sign is omitted; verify must also be absent, and encryption cannot be enabled.
verify: Check the representation produced by `sign` and return authenticated inner data before dispatch.
Signature verification is disabled when verify is omitted; sign must also be absent.
encodedType: Transform input/output category; conversion belongs to auth representation rather than an extra JSON parser.
any.
Preserve the existing general representation contract.
Pass canonical JSON text to transforms.
Pass UTF-8 bytes to transforms.
namespaces: Exact installed namespace names to which this plugin applies; this does not create namespaces.
All installed namespaces.

credentials: Portable explicit credential data or an async resolver receiving the actual admitted flow context. It does not discover native bootstrap tokens by guessing payload fields.

maxReplayEntriesPerPeer: Maximum retained request IDs per admitted peer, independent from provider concurrency and keyed outcome storage. Active IDs remain held through actual business and stream cleanup; completed IDs follow bounded TTL retention.
1024; a positive safe integer is required.

onRejected: Observe frozen replayLedgerFull or groupReplayFull refusals. Callback failure is reported with INTERNAL and the original cause; it does not replace OVERLOADED.

void or Promise<void>; failures are contained and reported.

sections.content: Complete paired transforms and optional explicit handshake credential capabilities captured by auth. Native acquisition and accepted identity remain separate owners.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import authFeature from @migaia/rpc-host/plugins/auth, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use authFeature when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when authFeature does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
Cold native flow definition; each receiving Host owns its own hooks and exact cleanup.
encrypt: Encrypt the prepared nonce/counter binding before signing; input and output must match encodedType and decrypt reverses this operation.
Encryption is disabled when encrypt is omitted; enabling it requires decrypt and both sign and verify.
Use the representation consumed by the actual paired cryptographic transforms; identity transforms do not demonstrate authentication.
decrypt: After inbound signature verification, reverse `encrypt` before envelope admission; a throw rejects the envelope.
Decryption is disabled when decrypt is omitted; encrypt must also be absent.
sign: Sign the exact protected representation with its nonce/counter binding; return the representation consumed by verify.
Signing is disabled when sign is omitted; verify must also be absent, and encryption cannot be enabled.
verify: Check the representation produced by `sign` and return authenticated inner data before dispatch.
Signature verification is disabled when verify is omitted; sign must also be absent.
encodedType: Transform input/output category; conversion belongs to auth representation rather than an extra JSON parser.
any.
Preserve the existing general representation contract.
Pass canonical JSON text to transforms.
Pass UTF-8 bytes to transforms.
namespaces: Exact installed namespace names to which this plugin applies; this does not create namespaces.
All installed namespaces.
Supply explicit application credentials and the real verifier for selected native namespaces; launch tokens are not inferred.
credentials: Portable explicit credential data or an async resolver receiving the actual admitted flow context. It does not discover native bootstrap tokens by guessing payload fields.
No explicit credentials.
maxReplayEntriesPerPeer: Maximum retained request IDs per admitted peer, independent from provider concurrency and keyed outcome storage. Active IDs remain held through actual business and stream cleanup; completed IDs follow bounded TTL retention.
1024; a positive safe integer is required.
Bound authenticated request-ID history without substituting provider concurrency for replay capacity.
onRejected: Observe frozen replayLedgerFull or groupReplayFull refusals. Callback failure is reported with INTERNAL and the original cause; it does not replace OVERLOADED.
onRejected.rejection: Canonical IRpcProviderRejection from @migaia/rpc-contract/errors with actual admitted peer, correlation, method and reason.
void or Promise<void>; failures are contained and reported.
No replay refusal observer.
Distinguish request-ID replay capacity from other OVERLOADED reasons.
verifyCredentials: Receives remote credential data, peer hello and actual flow context; return void/Promise<void> to accept or throw to reject.
verifyCredentials.auth: Portable credentials decoded from the peer hello, or undefined when it supplied none.
verifyCredentials.peer: The actual normalized peer identity from this handshake; it is not inferred from business payload.
verifyCredentials.context: The owning handshake flow context with its actual direction, namespace and cancellation signal.
Return void or a fulfilled Promise to accept. Throw or reject to fail authentication before provider execution.
No credential verifier.
Complete paired transforms and optional explicit handshake credential capabilities captured by auth. Native acquisition and accepted identity remain separate owners.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Handshake credentials and paired envelope transforms run in the installed flow. Authentication completes before provider dispatch; acquisition of native credentials remains explicit.
Install before the first transport starts and restrict namespaces when the policy should apply only to selected links.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxBufferedBytesPerSource

blocks.text: verifier 或凭据解析器抛出、拒绝时，auth 在本地错误的 `cause` 上保留原始错误。用 `errorMapFeature(map)` 决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，例如把含凭据的细节换成公开提示。本地抛出的错误、`report`、警告和只读观察插件看到的仍是原始错误，与插件安装先后无关。它可放在宿主 `plugins` 或传输 `features`，传输级覆盖宿主级。

`map(error, context)` 必须同步返回 `Error`、可移植值或 `undefined`。返回值就是发给对端的错误内容，不自动附加原错的原因链。回调抛错或返回值无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。返回 Promise/thenable 时报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`，立即按原规则发送，不等待它，因此同一会话的后续消息不会被它卡住；迟到的 Promise 拒绝仍会单独报告。
没有 `errorMapFeature` 时，未认证对端收到的握手拒绝默认隐藏细节；其他错误保留完整的原因链。跨进程或线程会还原成新对象，不保证与发送方原错 `===`。需要隐藏对端可见信息时配置映射，本地日志和原因链仍可用于排查。
连接或 Auth 安装在验签中途关闭时，这次入站处理按取消结束，不再报告为认证失败；原始取消原因仍保留，真正的验签失败照常报告。直接执行 Auth SDK 阶段的调用者，在安装关闭后会得到现有的 `UtilsAbortError` 及原始 `cause`，而不是 `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`。

blocks.text: `FeatureScope` 唯一解析覆盖顺序：单次调用 `options.timeout/retry`、所在传输 plugin 的 feature、链路策略 plugin。单次值只接受完整 feature 实例或 `false`，不接受数字或配置对象。`timeout: false` 不启用 feature 超时，持续等待响应；已经继承的上游剩余期限仍递减。`retry: false` 禁用重试。只有发起方的标量调用和 group 重试，stream 从不重放、只使用 timeout；转发跳不重新开始预算。
进入 provider 前剩余截止时间已经耗尽的调用，以 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` 拒绝，不执行 provider；`before-start` 的取消语义保持不变。
所有调用种类支持 `signal`，单向调用物理发送之后也能向下游传播取消。provider 读取自己的 `context.signal`。取消不等于杀进程，也不回滚业务副作用。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、`stack`、`cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors`。超时或断开不证明业务未执行；非幂等操作须先对账再考虑重试。

`send`、`request` 等返回 Promise 的调用通过拒绝传播非法 `idempotencyKey`、transfer 准入被拒绝或命名空间已关闭的错误，保留各入口原有的 `source/code` 和 `cause`；非法 key 仍为 `CONTRACT_INVALID`。使用 `await` 或 `Promise.catch` 处理失败。`dispatch` 仍同步返回 `void` 并向 reporter 交付失败，`stream` 与 `streamTo` 仍返回延迟启动的异步迭代器。
公开 provider 注册失败以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝，原注册错误直接保留在 `cause`；错误说明不通过调用异常的字符串转换来生成。关闭后，待决调用以 `ENDPOINT_DISPOSED` 结算，实际载体关闭会拒绝仍被挂住的写入；不要求任意业务 Promise 因关闭而强行完成。

自定义 plugin 作者从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 开始。观察入口是 `/plugins/probe`；旧 `/plugin`、`/probe`、endpoint、per-session Peer 和 v1/JSON-RPC profile 已删除。rpc 家族可以直接依赖 `@migaia/rpc-contract`；只需错误码时导入 `/error-code`，不会带入协议与编解码执行代码。

symbols.name: RpcPoolErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Stable pool-owned semantic codes for invalid configuration, closed admission, queue overflow, queued abort and aggregated member cleanup. Native error classes and original causes remain intact.
symbols.core:
invalidOptions: Construction or resize input is invalid; fix the option before native member acquisition.
poolClosed: A closing or closed pool rejects a new operation or resize; create a new pool for new work.
queueFull: All client slots are busy and the bounded FIFO is full; no member receives the rejected operation.
callAborted: An operation was cancelled while waiting in the FIFO; native AbortError cause retains the exact signal reason.
closeFailed: Every member close was attempted and one or more failed; AggregateError retains errors and the first original cause.
transportUnsupported: POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED rejects listen/connect-to-parent before opening a member.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

members.name: invalidOptions
members.description: Invalid construction or resize arguments are rejected before any native acquisition.

members.name: transportUnsupported
members.description: Listener and parent-only sources cannot open independent members; choose spawn or connect.

members.name: poolClosed
members.description: Closing/closed admission rejects new calls, first stream next or resize; create another pool.

members.name: queueFull
members.description: All available slots are reserved and the bounded FIFO is full; the new call never reaches a * Peer.

members.name: callAborted
members.description: Queued cancellation removes only its FIFO entry; a native AbortError retains the signal reason * on cause.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
invalidOptions: Construction or resize input is invalid; fix the option before native member acquisition.
poolClosed: A closing or closed pool rejects a new operation or resize; create a new pool for new work.
queueFull: All client slots are busy and the bounded FIFO is full; no member receives the rejected operation.
callAborted: An operation was cancelled while waiting in the FIFO; native AbortError cause retains the exact signal reason.
closeFailed: Every member close was attempted and one or more failed; AggregateError retains errors and the first original cause.
transportUnsupported: POOL_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED rejects listen/connect-to-parent before opening a member.

symbols.name: RpcProcessErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package; values are the strings on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
usageSampleFailed: `PROCESS_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED`: CPU or memory sampling failed; show unavailable.
hostInvalidOption: `PROCESS_HOST_INVALID_OPTION`: a host option is invalid; fix the named field.
hostClosed: `PROCESS_HOST_CLOSED`: the outlet is releasing; use a new host or Peer.
handshakeTimeout: `PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT`: the handshake did not finish in time; open a new channel.
authRejected: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`: the credential was refused; do not retry with it.
channelClosed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED`: work on a closed channel; reconnect and reconcile.
connectFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`: connecting to the other process, starting it, or setting up part of the channel failed. If the system call that starts the process or opens its streams throws, you get that same error object with its type, stack and fields intact. Its `source` becomes this package and its system `code` (such as `ENOENT`) becomes `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`, one stable value to check. An already wrapped failure keeps the original on `cause`.
listenFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED`: preparing to listen, or binding the listening address, failed. You receive the same system error object, with its type, stack and other fields unchanged; it only gains this package as `source` and `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED` as `code`. Both the reported error and the rejected promise keep the original `cause` chain.
pluginInvalidOption: `PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION`: a plugin or source option is invalid.
resilienceInvalidOption: `PROCESS_RESILIENCE_INVALID_OPTION`: a governance limit is invalid.
connectionLimit: `PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT`: connection, rate or payload limit; the call did not run.
instanceUnhealthy: `PROCESS_INSTANCE_UNHEALTHY`: the target is suspended until a healthy replacement is ready.
healthPingFailed: `PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED`: a health ping failed; supervision restarts it.
terminalCall: `PROCESS_TERMINAL_CALL`: the registration is terminal and refuses calls.
liquidated: `PROCESS_LIQUIDATED`: the registration was liquidated; create a new one.

members.name: hostClosed

members.name: handshakeTimeout
members.description: Handshake exceeded its scheduler deadline; caller must open a new channel.

members.name: authRejected
members.description: Peer authorization failed; caller must not retry without valid credentials.

members.name: channelClosed
members.description: A closed channel rejected work or its close observer/resource cleanup failed; inspect * cause/errors.

members.name: connectFailed
members.description: Dial or launch could not establish a channel; caller may inspect the original cause.

members.name: listenFailed
members.description: The requested local listener could not bind; caller must choose an available address.

members.name: pluginInvalidOption
members.description: Invalid process-plugin options are rejected before launch; caller must correct the named field.

members.name: resilienceInvalidOption
members.description: Invalid resilience limits, ownership, or health configuration; correct the named field before * opening a connection.

members.name: connectionLimit
members.description: A connection, call-rate, or payload limit rejected admission before provider execution.

members.name: instanceUnhealthy
members.description: A shared target is suspended after an explicit instance-health event until a ready replacement * exists.

members.name: healthPingFailed
members.description: An enabled native health ping returned false before its supervision deadline; the owner must * restart the unit.

members.name: terminalCall
members.description: A terminal registration rejects new remote calls before they reach its inactive generation.

members.name: liquidated
members.description: A liquidated registration cannot restart; the caller must create a new registration.

symbols.purpose: Creates a frozen synchronous JSON codec with explicit version metadata. Its portable profile admits null, booleans, finite numbers, strings, dense arrays and ordinary records; encoding validates and projects supported data before stringify, while decoding parses and validates without freezing the result. Unsupported scalars such as NaN reject rather than silently becoming null. This differs from the native-JSON registry plugin, and the version is not embedded in the encoded text.

members.name: runtime
members.description: Caller-owned reactive Runtime used for Resource/computed state; query/Host disposal does not dispose it.

members.name: scope
members.description: Optional entity scope used only to prove that an invalidation cannot be unrelated.

members.name: matches
members.description: Optional change predicate; failures are reported and conservatively refresh the query.

members.name: keepPreviousData
members.description: Preserve the last visible value while Resource refreshes; defaults to true.

members.name: equals
members.signature: readonly equals?: (previous: T, next: T) => boolean;
members.description: Optional equality policy preserving the prior visible value when true; omission accepts the new value.

members.name: timeoutMs
members.description: Optional finite non-negative per-generation deadline, driven by the Host scheduler; omission is unbounded.

members.name: signal
members.description: External cancellation for the whole query instance.

members.name: report
members.description: Report-only sink for stale settlement and cleanup failures.

invalidate.where: Declarative scalar filter on user payload fields; reserved cache fields are rejected.
invalidate.ctx: Original native deletion context with optional count mode; forwarded once unchanged.

mode: Required finite mode captured once before native installation or layout work.
Index half-precision casts with the current metric opclass; 4000 indexed dimensions maximum.
Index vector signs as bits with Hamming distance, then order the recalled original vectors exactly.
Choose the deployed pgvector layout deliberately; casts are lossy and can reject unrepresentable values with the original SQL_FAILED cause.

blocks.text: 宿主默认自动检测。设置 autoDetect:false 时，使用所选后端能力前先 await host.detect()。版本满足不等于安装了 Search 模块。

nodeRedisDriver接受node-redis 6的pool；ioredisDriver接受ioredis 6 client；bunRedisDriver接受Bun RedisClient，分别从/node-redis、/ioredis、/bun导入。它们借用已连接客户端，不关闭原对象。ioredis内部连接禁用未确认命令重发；node-redis保留同一pool租约和EXEC逐项错误；Bun在MULTI前拒绝二进制输入。根入口不加载SDK，每个订阅消耗独立连接。
标准记录字段查询在客户端执行，不提供标准secondaryIndexes、SQL或RDF。文本/字节缺失为null，记录为undefined。物理索引可能残留已过期条目，读取会核对真实键；前缀删除使用有序索引，inspectLocks和部分清理需SCAN，成本包含实际扫描候选。

本包错误source为storage.backend.redis，REDIS_FAILED表示原生命令/连接/EXEC故障，TRANSACTION_FAILED表示未分类的业务回调/草稿失败，DECODE_FAILED表示协议或持久化数据不能解码。共享契约、host和本包已有错误保留身份，原始错误沿cause可达。dispose重复返回同一主Promise，符号释放用另一个报告型Promise，只清理自有订阅和租约。

blocks.text: 宿主默认自动检测。设置 autoDetect:false 时，使用所选后端能力前先 await host.detect()。版本满足不等于安装了 Search 模块。

nodeRedisDriver接受node-redis 6的pool；ioredisDriver接受ioredis 6 client；bunRedisDriver接受Bun RedisClient，分别从/node-redis、/ioredis、/bun导入。它们借用已连接客户端，不关闭原对象。ioredis内部连接禁用未确认命令重发；node-redis保留同一pool租约和EXEC逐项错误；Bun在MULTI前拒绝二进制输入。根入口不加载SDK，每个订阅消耗独立连接。
标准记录字段查询在客户端执行，不提供标准secondaryIndexes、SQL或RDF。文本/字节缺失为null，记录为undefined。物理索引可能残留已过期条目，读取会核对真实键；前缀删除使用有序索引，inspectLocks和部分清理需SCAN，成本包含实际扫描候选。

本包错误source为storage.backend.redis，REDIS_FAILED表示原生命令/连接/EXEC故障，TRANSACTION_FAILED表示未分类的业务回调/草稿失败，DECODE_FAILED表示协议或持久化数据不能解码。共享契约、host和本包已有错误保留身份，原始错误沿cause可达。dispose重复返回同一主Promise，符号释放用另一个报告型Promise，只清理自有订阅和租约。

import { Store } from 'oxigraph'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { rdf } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { term } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sparqlBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql'

await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint: oxigraphEndpoint(new Store()) })]
})

  subject: term.iri('urn:example:alice'),
  predicate: term.iri('urn:example:name'),
  object: term.literal('Alice'),
  graph: term.defaultGraph
}
await store
  .use(rdf)
  .add([quad, { ...quad, subject: term.iri('urn:example:bob'), object: term.literal('Bob') }])
const selected = store
  .use(rdf)
  .match({ predicate: quad.predicate })
  .where((value) => value.object.value === 'Alice')
console.log(await selected.count())
console.log(await selected.delete())
console.log(await store.use(rdf).match({}).count())

import { Store } from 'oxigraph'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { rdf } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { ConcurrencyPolicy } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { term } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sparqlBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql'
import { oxigraphEndpoint } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql/oxigraph'

await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint: oxigraphEndpoint(new Store()) })]
})
const store = host.backend('sparql')
const quad = {
  subject: term.iri('urn:example:alice'),
  predicate: term.iri('urn:example:name'),
  object: term.literal('Alice'),
  graph: term.defaultGraph
}
await store.use(rdf).add([quad])
await store
  .tx()
  .concurrency(ConcurrencyPolicy.optimistic({ retries: 1 }))

    await scope.use(rdf).add([{ ...quad, object: term.literal('Ada') }])
  })

import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { kv, records, ttl, counter } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { lockKey } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sqliteBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite'
import { nodeSqliteDriver } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite/node'
await using connection = nodeSqliteDriver('./example-settings.sqlite')
await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sqliteBackendPlugin({ driver: connection })] as const
})
const store = host.org('10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001').backend('sqlite')
await store
  .tx()
  .lock(lockKey.text('example:status'))
  .run(async (tx) => {
    await tx.use(kv).setMany([
      { key: 'example:status', value: 'ready' },
      { key: ['example', 1], value: 'first', ttlMs: 60000 }
    ])
    await tx.putRecord({ name: 'Ada' }, 'example:user')
    await tx.use(ttl).expire(lockKey.text('example:status'), 60000)
    await tx.set('example:count', '0')
    await tx.use(counter).increment('example:count')
  })
console.log(await store.get('example:status'))
console.log(await store.get('example:count'))
console.log((await store.use(records).query().all()).length >= 1)

rows: 传入的不是 `atomDef`/`derivedDef`/... 产出的合法定义对象。
`atom override resolved to a read-only definition`
目标（可能经 override 解析后）是 `derived`，没有写语义。
`atom override must preserve the original write contract`
违反 第 3.4 节 的三条替换规则。
推测读之间出现循环依赖。
`focusDef requires at least one path segment`
`<label> cannot read path segment <key>` / `<label> cannot write path segment <key>`
路径中途遇到 `null`/非对象值。
读取时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`cannot write a removed split def item`
写入时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`keyOf` 对不同元素算出了相同的 key。
`family maxSize must be a positive integer`
`family definitions require WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry; enable these capabilities in the host sandbox`
宿主环境缺少这两个全局能力。
`<context> returned a thenable — async initial values are not supported here; compose with @migaia/resource instead (...)`
初值/工厂返回值是 thenable。
`atomDef({...})` 初值克隆失败（`structuredClone` 抛错）
`primitive initial value cannot be cloned independently`
值本身不可结构化克隆，原异常在 `cause`。
实例式 atom 的 `runtime` 与调用方绑定的 runtime 不一致。
释放多个实例/条目时不止一个抛错，原因各自保留在 `errors[]`。
`AtomStore` 内部所有权登记（继承自 `@migaia/reactive`）
`this node is already owned by another Runtime`
同一个 store 对象被 `claimOwnership` 到两个不同的 Runtime——正常使用路径下不会触发，出现即说明把同一个 store 错误地跨 Runtime 复用了。

symbols.name: IAtomDefinition
symbols.purpose: Readable union of all four branded pure definition kinds; writable argument types are erased on this read-only boundary.
symbols.core:
kind: Discriminant chosen by the definition constructor; it selects source, factory, derived or writable-derived instantiation.
debugLabel: Optional caller-selected diagnostic name; does not identify or merge definition tokens.
Omitted by ordinary constructors; family constructors supply their own label defaults.
init: Initial template supplied to atomDef; thenables reject at construction. Mutable object templates are cloned per store using host structuredClone.
create: No-argument synchronous initializer, called when a store first materializes this source or when permitted preview needs it. Return a nonthenable value; exceptions propagate and preview may be abandoned.
Initial T owned by this store; callers must create independent mutable containers. A thenable result rejects with INVALID_OPTION.
previewSafe: Whether an unmaterialized source factory may run in speculative preview; safe factories must be pure and deterministic.
false for atomDefFactory and true for previewSafeAtomDefFactory; fixed by the constructor.
read: Synchronous derived callback receiving the current store getter. Read dependencies with get(definition), return T, and let throws propagate through the owning reactive evaluation.
read.get: Store-issued IAtomGet; takes a definition created by this package and returns its current scoped value with dependency tracking.
Derived T; no asynchronous result is awaited by the read contract.
write: Synchronous caller write callback receiving store get, store set and original args. The store invokes it inside batch and untracked; its return or throw is preserved.
write.get: Store-issued reader for current definition values.
write.set: Store-issued writer accepting a writable definition followed by its exact arguments.
write.args: Original arguments supplied by the caller to store.set for this writable definition.
Caller-defined Result, forwarded unchanged by store.set; no promise is awaited by the synchronous callback boundary.
equals: Synchronous equality callback for derived values. Receives new and previous candidates, returns true to retain equivalence; exceptions follow reactive computation or preview failure handling.
equals.a: First candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
equals.b: Second candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
Boolean indicating semantic equality; comparisons are synchronous and are not awaited.
No custom comparator; the owning reactive computed uses its Object.is default.
symbols.advanced: Share a pure definition between stores while keeping each store value and lifetime independent.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
kind: Discriminant chosen by the definition constructor; it selects source, factory, derived or writable-derived instantiation.
debugLabel: Optional caller-selected diagnostic name; does not identify or merge definition tokens.
Omitted by ordinary constructors; family constructors supply their own label defaults.
read: Synchronous derived callback receiving the current store getter. Read dependencies with get(definition), return T, and let throws propagate through the owning reactive evaluation.
read.get: Store-issued IAtomGet; takes a definition created by this package and returns its current scoped value with dependency tracking.
Derived T; no asynchronous result is awaited by the read contract.
equals: Synchronous equality callback for derived values. Receives new and previous candidates, returns true to retain equivalence; exceptions follow reactive computation or preview failure handling.
equals.a: First candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
equals.b: Second candidate supplied by the owning computation or preview.
Boolean indicating semantic equality; comparisons are synchronous and are not awaited.
No custom comparator; the owning reactive computed uses its Object.is default.

symbols.name: createAtomStore
symbols.signature: export declare function createAtomStore(runtime: IRuntime): IAtomStore;
symbols.purpose: Creates a store: a scope that keeps its own value for every definition it reads. Definitions (`atomDef`, `derivedDef`, ...) hold no value, so the same definitions give separate values in each store, for example one store per server request or per test. A value is created the first time its definition is read and kept until `release(definition)` or `dispose()`.
symbols.core:
runtime: IRuntime returned by @migaia/reactive createRuntime; it owns dependency graphs, batching, idle cleanup and error reporting.
Caller-owned IAtomStore; dispose it to release its subscriptions and instantiated graph nodes.
parameters: runtime: IRuntime
symbols.returns: IAtomStore

symbols.name: IAtomStore
symbols.purpose: A store returned by `createAtomStore` or `defaultAtomStore`: it keeps one value per definition, and its caller decides when to dispose it.
symbols.core:
runtime: The exact external IRuntime passed at store construction; it owns dependency tracking, batching and error reporting.
disposed: Terminal store flag set before disposal begins; subsequent state operations reject rather than recreating nodes.
size: Current number of instantiated definitions strongly retained by this store, excluding uncommitted preview entries.
get: Resolves active overrides, lazily materializes a definition and reads with Runtime dependency tracking.
get.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
Current scoped T; disposed stores use ATOM_STORE_DISPOSED and invalid definitions use INVALID_OPTION. Initialization/read failures preserve their owning semantics.
peek: Resolves and lazily materializes a definition but reads without creating a dependency edge in the current capture.
peek.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
Current untracked T with the same admission and initialization failures as get.
preview: Reads speculative state without permanently materializing uncommitted definitions. Existing instances are peeked; new factory values require previewSafe and cached previews expire through Runtime idle cleanup.
preview.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
Speculative T. Unsafe source creation uses PREVIEW_UNSAFE, preview cycles use CIRCULAR_PREVIEW; abandoned values need not become committed state.
set: Writes the resolved target inside Runtime batch/untracked. Primitive targets accept value or update(previous); writable-derived targets receive their exact args.
set.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
set.update: For a source definition (`atomDef`, `atomDefFactory`): the new value, or a function receiving the previous value and returning the next one. The function runs synchronously and its throw propagates.
set.args: Primitive: one value or synchronous previous-to-next callback, with throws propagated. Writable-derived: the Args declared by writableDef, forwarded unchanged.
Undefined for primitive writes or the writable callback Result. Writing a read-only target rejects with OVERRIDE_CONTRACT.
setMany: Writes several source definitions in one batch, so subscribers are notified once. Every entry is resolved and every updater runs before anything is written: if one entry is rejected or one updater throws, every definition keeps its old value.
setMany.entries: Pairs of a source definition (`atomDef`, `atomDefFactory`) and a new value or a function from the previous value to the next one. A definition listed twice gives its later updater the value computed by the earlier entry; an updater that reads another definition sees the value from before the call.
Undefined. An entry that an override routes to a non-source definition rejects the whole call with OVERRIDE_CONTRACT; an updater error propagates unchanged.
sub: Establishes dependency observation immediately without calling the listener initially. Later change callbacks run synchronously untracked; throws are reported to runtime.reportError and do not kill other subscriptions.
sub.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
sub.onChange: Caller synchronous no-argument notification; read the current snapshot with store.peek if needed. No result is used or awaited.
External IDisposer: a no-argument idempotent unsubscribe function. Store disposal also releases active subscriptions.
override: Adds one reversible read-routing layer while preserving write contracts. Read-only definitions accept same-value replacements; primitive targets require primitive/factory replacements; writable-derived targets preserve Args and Result.
override.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
override.replacement: Compatible definition token created by the same public constructors, with value and write types required by the corresponding overload.
Idempotent undo function; target state is retained. Incompatible contracts use OVERRIDE_CONTRACT and cyclic routes use CYCLIC_OVERRIDE, rolling back the attempted layer.
isObserved: Checks the resolved definition existing node observation state without creating an instance.
isObserved.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
True when an existing node is observed; false otherwise. Disposed stores and invalid definitions still reject.
release: Releases only one instantiated definition, first trying its override-resolved target and trying the original definition only if the first removes no instance. Other store instances remain intact.
release.definition: Definition token returned by atomDef, a derived/optic constructor or family lookup; the store owns its scoped instance.
True if an instance was removed and disposed, false when neither key had one. Disposal failures propagate.
dispose: Idempotently marks terminal and clears uncommitted preview values plus overrides, releases subscriptions, then drains instance ownership in reverse order. Retaining the disposed store does not retain values through its preview cache.
No result after cleanup attempts. One collected failure is thrown unchanged; multiple failures throw DISPOSAL_FAILED AggregateError with original errors reachable.

members.description: Writes source definitions within one batch and one untracked operation; subscribers are notified once after the batch. The call first resolves every entry and runs every updater in input order, then writes. An entry that resolves to a non-source definition (OVERRIDE_CONTRACT) or an updater that throws leaves every atom unchanged. A repeated definition's updater receives the value from its previous entry; updaters reading other atoms see the values from before the call. Each entry keeps its own value type: `Ts` is inferred from the definitions only, so entries of different types can share one call and each updater is checked against its own definition.

symbols.name: computeUniqueKeys
symbols.purpose: Computes source keys synchronously and rejects duplicates using Set membership. The returned key array is frozen; source items are unchanged.
symbols.core:
items: Application source array in its current order.
keyOf: Synchronous callback receiving the current source item and zero-based source index, returning the application key. A throw stops the operation unchanged; no asynchronous key is awaited.
label: Application label used when duplicate keys produce INVALID_OPTION; the implementation adds [store], so do not repeat that prefix.
Frozen readonly key array, or Error with INVALID_OPTION for a duplicate key; extractor exceptions propagate.
parameters: items: readonly T[]
keyOf: (item: T, index: number) => Key
label: string
symbols.returns: readonly Key[]

const StoreKeyedErrorCode = {
  atomStoreDisposed: 'ATOM_STORE_DISPOSED',
  disposalFailed: 'DISPOSAL_FAILED',
  circularPreview: 'CIRCULAR_PREVIEW',
  cyclicOverride: 'CYCLIC_OVERRIDE',
  overrideContract: 'OVERRIDE_CONTRACT',
  previewUnsafe: 'PREVIEW_UNSAFE',
  crossRuntime: 'CROSS_RUNTIME',
  envUnsupported: 'ENV_UNSUPPORTED',
  opticAccessFailed: 'OPTIC_ACCESS_FAILED',
  invalidOption: 'INVALID_OPTION'
} as const
type IStoreKeyedErrorCode = (typeof StoreKeyedErrorCode)[keyof typeof StoreKeyedErrorCode]

rows: 传入的不是 `atomDef`/`derivedDef`/... 产出的合法定义对象。
`atom override resolved to a read-only definition`
目标（可能经 override 解析后）是 `derived`，没有写语义。
`atom override must preserve the original write contract`
违反 第 3.4 节 的三条替换规则。
推测读之间出现循环依赖。
`focusDef requires at least one path segment`
`<label> cannot read path segment <key>` / `<label> cannot write path segment <key>`
路径中途遇到 `null`/非对象值。
读取时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`cannot write a removed split def item`
写入时该 key 已不在源数组里。
`keyOf` 对不同元素算出了相同的 key。
`family maxSize must be a positive integer`
`family definitions require WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry; enable these capabilities in the host sandbox`
宿主环境缺少这两个全局能力。
`<context> returned a thenable — async initial values are not supported here; compose with @migaia/resource instead (...)`
初值/工厂返回值是 thenable。
`atomDef({...})` 初值克隆失败（`structuredClone` 抛错）
`primitive initial value cannot be cloned independently`
值本身不可结构化克隆，原异常在 `cause`。
实例式 atom 的 `runtime` 与调用方绑定的 runtime 不一致。
释放多个实例/条目时不止一个抛错，原因各自保留在 `errors[]`。
`AtomStore` 内部所有权登记（继承自 `@migaia/reactive`）
`this node is already owned by another Runtime`
同一个 store 对象被 `claimOwnership` 到两个不同的 Runtime——正常使用路径下不会触发，出现即说明把同一个 store 错误地跨 Runtime 复用了。

symbols.core:
New empty KeyedSplitCache with strong key/item retention until prune or clear. Cache removal never disposes items automatically; provide prune onEvict when the caller owns item cleanup.
get: Looks up a stored value without creation or truthiness filtering.

of: Returns a truthy cached item or synchronously invokes the creator and replaces the value for that key.

No result; the same cache object can be reused.

symbols.purpose: Installs a supplied parser on the worker and handles decode responses and bounded encode streams. Pair with workerPlugin or workerParser; attach returned handler to host messages. Parser lifetime remains caller-owned.
symbols.core:
parser: ISerializeParser from @migaia/serialize/plugins or a compatible implementation. encode(value,{signal,context}) may return chunk, iterable or async iterable; decode(chunk,context) returns a value or Promise. Worker sets context to serialize-worker; parser failures use only canonical RPC rejection, retaining name, message, stack, source, code, cause and aggregate errors. Already-delivered chunks remain available before the stream reports failure.
post: Synchronous host callback receiving raw message and optional readonly transfer list; return void, normally forward to worker-global postMessage. Native send failures follow RPC transport policy.
IManagedRpcHandler callable with raw host event.data, plus close/dispose/pendingCount/disposed. Invalid or inaccessible factory parser members are INVALID_OPTION: native failures retain identity/class/stack, complete foreign identities remain unchanged, and untaggable failures remain on cause. Encode uses two initial credits and acknowledgements. Stream failure is a canonical RPC rejection; an iterator.return failure is attached with the primary first in the reachable error chain. Handler disposal does not call parser.dispose.
parameters: parser: ISerializeParser
post: (message: unknown, transfer?: readonly unknown[]) => void
symbols.returns: IManagedRpcHandler

symbols.name: IWorkerLike
symbols.purpose: The same borrowed native worker port accepted through IWorkerMessagePort, with an additional optional terminate callback. Parser disposal releases its endpoint but leaves the Worker alive by default; terminateOnDispose explicitly opts into native termination.
symbols.core:
postMessage: Synchronous host callback sending a raw RPC envelope; do not reinterpret it as an application payload. Transfer is the optional native list and return value is unused; host errors propagate into transport handling.
postMessage.value: Original frame value supplied by the canonical worker transport; forward it unchanged to native postMessage rather than wrapping it as another application request.
postMessage.transfer: Optional native transfer list received from send options; omit for ordinary cloning.
Void after the host accepted the send; it does not mean peer computation completed.
start: Optional synchronous native MessagePort start operation borrowed from the supplied port. The canonical worker transport invokes it before installing its message listener; Worker-like ports without this method need no substitute.
Void after native startup; this operation does not acquire ownership of the port or terminate it during cleanup.
Omitted for ports that do not require explicit message delivery startup.
addEventListener: Host installs a listener for message, error or messageerror; RPC owns subscriptions and dispatch. Do not steal a mutable onmessage slot for the main-side adapter.
addEventListener.type: Event name supplied by the RPC adapter: message, error or messageerror.
addEventListener.listener: Synchronous callback receiving an event-like object with data, origin, source and type as applicable; return void, and transport isolates listener failures.
Void after listener registration.
removeEventListener: Host removes the exact type/listener pair installed by the transport during endpoint cleanup.
removeEventListener.type: Previously registered event name from the transport.
removeEventListener.listener: Exact callback identity received during registration.
Void after listener removal; native cleanup failures reject endpoint disposal.
terminate: Optional synchronous no-argument host cleanup callback; called after endpoint cleanup only when terminateOnDispose is true, even if endpoint cleanup failed.
Void; a failure rejects disposal alone or joins CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

const UtilsErrorCode = {
  invalidArgument: 'INVALID_ARGUMENT',
  nonErrorValue: 'NON_ERROR_VALUE',
  envUnsupported: 'ENV_UNSUPPORTED',
  aborted: 'ABORTED',
  deadlineExceeded: 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED',
  schedulerRunaway: 'SCHEDULER_RUNAWAY',
  errorIdentityConflict: 'ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT',
  errorChainInvalid: 'ERROR_CHAIN_INVALID',
  cloneUnsupported: 'CLONE_UNSUPPORTED',
  invalidEncoding: 'INVALID_ENCODING',
  limiterClosed: 'LIMITER_CLOSED',
  reentrantCall: 'REENTRANT_CALL',
  configUnsupported: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED',
  configReadonly: 'CONFIG_READONLY',
  configConflict: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT',
  configLimitExceeded: 'CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
  configPathInvalid: 'CONFIG_PATH_INVALID',
  objectPathInvalid: 'OBJECT_PATH_INVALID',
  formatInvalid: 'FORMAT_INVALID',
  formatValueMissing: 'FORMAT_VALUE_MISSING',
  numberFormatInvalid: 'NUMBER_FORMAT_INVALID'
} as const

blocks.text: 全包统一使用的稳定语义码，`IUtilsErrorCode` 是其取值的联合类型。除 `UtilsError` 子类外，`base64ToBytes`/`object-path`/`config` 等模块抛出的原生 `TypeError`/`RangeError` 也会通过 `Object.defineProperty` 挂上对应的 `code`（与 `source: 'foundation.utils'`），可用同一套判断逻辑识别。
按用途理解全部错误码：

items: `INVALID_ARGUMENT`：参数类型、范围或互斥组合错误；修正调用参数。
`NON_ERROR_VALUE`：非 `Error` 异常值已被 `toError()` 转换；从 `cause` 读取原始值。
`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`：宿主缺少 `structuredClone` 等必要能力；更换环境或实现。
`ABORTED`：外部信号请求取消；停止协作式工作并传播取消原因。
`DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`：操作、尝试或总流程超时；结合 `scope`、`timeoutMs` 选择重试或降级。
`SCHEDULER_RUNAWAY`：虚拟时钟一次推进超过 10000 个任务；排查同刻递归调度。
`ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT`：已有错误身份与新 `source`/`code` 冲突；保留原身份。
`ERROR_CHAIN_INVALID`：收到的序列化错误树或其 plain data 违反字段、标量、深度、数量或文本字节约束；修正输入或使用边界自己的处理策略。
`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`：值不能被 `structuredClone` 复制；先转换为可克隆数据。
`INVALID_ENCODING`：编码输入不是规范形式；按错误偏移修正输入。
`LIMITER_CLOSED`：并发限制器已关闭；停止提交或创建新实例。
`REENTRANT_CALL`：同一实例发生禁止的重入；等待当前回调结束。
`CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`：配置含不支持的数据形状或属性；改用普通数据。
`CONFIG_READONLY`：尝试修改只读配置；从所有者侧创建新配置。
`CONFIG_CONFLICT`：配置来源的所有权、profile 或描述符冲突；统一契约再合并。
`CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`：配置键数、深度等超过安全上限；缩小输入或调整明确限制。
`CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`：配置路径为空、危险或分段无效；改用安全路径。
`OBJECT_PATH_INVALID`：对象路径无法安全解析；修正字符串或分段元组。
`FORMAT_INVALID`：模板、占位符或值不能安全格式化；修正模板或输入。
`FORMAT_VALUE_MISSING`：严格格式化缺少占位符值；补齐字段或调整策略。
`NUMBER_FORMAT_INVALID`：`Intl.NumberFormat` 拒绝 locale、选项、货币或数值；修正格式配置。

symbols.purpose: Creates a stateful reader/writer for one root object: `set` writes immutably and moves `value` to the new root, and hooks observe missing, blocked or failing paths and can replace read or written values.

ifMissing: Called when a read finds a missing segment.
Not set: missing reads just return `undefined`.
Use this hook to record absent path segments. It cannot supply a replacement; a missing read still returns undefined. Omission sends no notification.
ifBlocked: Called when a read meets a non-object on the way.
Not set.
Use this hook to distinguish a null or primitive parent from a missing property. The read still returns undefined; omission sends no notification.
ifFailed: Called when a getter throws during a read.
Not set: the error is not reported.
Use this hook to record a getter or proxy failure at its path. Returning normally still rethrows the original error; omission only removes the notification.
onGet: Called after each successful `get`; `event.replace(value)` changes the returned value.

onSet: Called before each `set` is applied; `event.replace(value)` changes the written value.

blocks.text: 统一的错误身份、包装与因果链遍历工具。
对一个属性执行恰好一次读取，保留 getter 的接收者；读取抛出时将原始值放在 `error`，不包装、不上报。调用方负责目标对象检查与失败策略。新代码中独立的单属性受保护读取应复用此原语。
外部 abort signal 的 reason 也通过同一入口读取：
失败后是重抛、包装、上报还是把原错误当作 reason，取决于调用方原有契约；此原语只返回读取结果。
`UtilsError` 是抽象基类，所有本包抛出的语义化错误都携带 `source: 'foundation.utils'` 与稳定的 `code`。`UtilsAbortError` 通过 `cause` 保留原始中止原因；`UtilsTimeoutError` 额外携带 `scope`（超时发生在单次操作 / 单次尝试 / 总截止时间的哪一层）与 `timeoutMs`。
就地给一个已存在的错误对象追加不可写的身份字段（`source`/`code`/`phase`/`detail`），不会替换或包装该错误。如果同一字段已存在且值不同，会抛出 `TypeError`（避免悄悄覆盖其他代码写入的身份信息）；值相同则视为幂等，直接返回。

blocks.code: function toError(value: unknown, options?: { readonly message?: string }): Error

blocks.text: 把任意抛出值规整为可诊断错误：原生 `Error` 或具有字符串 name/message/stack 的跨 realm/结构化错误形状原样返回；后者不保证 instanceof 本地 Error。其余值包装成携带 `cause: value` 的内部错误类型，消息优先取 `options.message`，其次（当抛出值本身是字符串时）取该字符串，否则用固定的兜底文案。

按 `cause` 链与 `AggregateError.errors` 展开遍历，返回访问到的全部节点（含起始 `error` 自身），用 `Set` 做同一值去重防止环路。`maxDepth`（默认 32）限制最大深度，超出后停止继续下探那一支。用 `cause: undefined` 创建的错误会在结果里留下一个 `undefined` 项，读取字段时请用可选链（`item?.code`）。

blocks.code: function combineErrors(errors: Iterable<unknown>, message: string): Error | undefined

blocks.text: 把 0 个、1 个或多个错误合并：0 个返回 `undefined`；1 个原样返回（经 `toError` 规整）；多个包装成 `AggregateError(errors, message)`。如果遍历 `errors` 这个 `Iterable` 本身抛错，会把已收集的错误连同该次遍历失败一起打包进 `AggregateError` 再抛出。

blocks.code:
function isUtilsError(value: unknown): value is UtilsError
function isUtilsAbortError(value: unknown): value is UtilsAbortError
function isUtilsTimeoutError(value: unknown): value is UtilsTimeoutError

blocks.text: 诊断形状守卫：检查 error-like 的 name/message/stack、source 为 foundation.utils，且 code 属于 UtilsErrorCode；abort/timeout 再核对对应 code。无需 instanceof 本地构造器，不用作来源认证。
带所有权语义的配置对象：只有经 `ownConfig` 接纳的对象才能被 `readonlyConfig`/`patchConfig`/`readConfigPath`/`combineConfig` 处理，用运行时 `WeakMap` 元数据（而非可伪造的字段）标记"这是一个受本包管理的配置根"。

blocks.code:
const ConfigProfile = { data: 'data', richRuntime: 'richRuntime' } as const
type IConfigProfile = 'data' | 'richRuntime'

blocks.text: `data`（默认）：只接受可移植的纯数据——普通对象、数组、`Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 等内置类型；拒绝函数。`richRuntime`：额外接受函数/可构造类（连同其自身属性与 `prototype` 一起深拷贝），用于确实需要在配置里携带回调或工厂的场景。

blocks.code: const CONFIG_DELETE: unique symbol

blocks.text: 在 `patchConfig`/`combineConfig` 的补丁对象中，把某个键的值设为这个符号，表示"删除该键"（而不是设为 `undefined`）。
深拷贝 `value` 得到一个独立的、被本包元数据标记为"已拥有"的图。要求根必须是普通对象（不能是数组）且不含 `symbol` 键。深拷贝过程中：

items: `Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 会被识别并对应构造新实例（而不是被当成普通对象递归展开字段）；
循环引用通过内部 `WeakMap` 保留同一图结构（不会无限递归，也不会拆散共享节点）；
`__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 键一律拒绝；
超过 `limits`（见下）中的深度/节点数/键数会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'` 的 `RangeError`。

blocks.text: 若 `value` 已经是某次 `ownConfig` 的返回值（元数据匹配同一 `profile`/`limits`），直接原样返回（幂等）；若元数据不匹配（例如同一对象先后用不同 `profile` 调用），抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'` 的 `TypeError`。

调用方拿到结果后有三种明确路径：内部继续把它作为稳定配置根；通过 `readonlyConfig()` 暴露可读但不可写的递归 Proxy；通过 `patchConfig()` 或 `combineConfig()` 派生下一份已拥有配置。不要直接把原始外部对象交给这些 API，也不要把“已拥有”误解为冻结——所有权保证来自独立图与内部登记，运行时写保护由 `readonlyConfig()` 单独提供。

blocks.code:
type IConfigLimits = {
  readonly maxDepth: number // 默认 256
  readonly maxNodes: number // 默认 100_000
  readonly maxKeys: number // 默认 1_000_000
  readonly maxPathLength: number // 默认 4096
  readonly maxSegmentLength: number // 默认 512
}

blocks.text: `limits` 不得超过包级默认上限。`patchConfig` 相对输入基准只能收紧，放宽会抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT；`combineConfig` 取所有输入与请求上限的逐项最小值，放宽请求被自动收紧，不因此抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT。

blocks.code: function readonlyConfig<T extends IConfigRecord>(value: IOwnedConfig<T>): T

blocks.text: 返回一个带缓存的只读对象，内部通过 `Proxy` 拦截修改；同一输入对象重复调用会返回同一个只读对象。读取时仍然访问原配置，没有再复制一份数据。任何写操作（`set`/`defineProperty`/`deleteProperty`/`setPrototypeOf`/`preventExtensions`，以及 `Map`/`Set`/`Date` 上的变更方法如 `.set()`/`.add()`/`.setFullYear()`）都会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_READONLY'` 的 `TypeError`。嵌套对象、`Map`、`Set` 和函数字段也会受到同样的写入保护。`value` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`。

对根做写时复制式覆盖：`patch` 中每个键要么设为新值（会被递归深拷贝并纳入所有权），要么设为 `CONFIG_DELETE` 表示删除。只有被改动路径上的节点被复制，未涉及的子树按引用共享。`patch` 为空对象且 `reuseUnchangedRoot`（默认 `true`）时直接返回 `base` 本身，不做任何拷贝。`patch` 必须是普通对象、键不能是 `symbol`、不能是访问器属性，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`；键名撞上 `__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 抛 `code: 'CONFIG_PATH_INVALID'`。注意：`patchConfig` 只在根一层应用补丁——要修改嵌套字段，先用 `get`/`set`（`/object` 模块）在应用层算出新的嵌套子树，再作为整体值放进 `patch`。
在 `/object` 模块的 `parseObjectPath` 基础上叠加 config 专属限制（长度上限可自定义，默认取包级默认值）并强制所有段都是字符串（不支持数字下标简写形式在 config 路径里独立出现，统一按字符串段处理）。
读取配置内某条路径，区分"键不存在"（`missing`）与"值就是 `undefined`"（`value: undefined`）。返回的对象/函数类型的值会自动包一层只读 Proxy（与 `readonlyConfig` 相同的包装逻辑），保证读到的嵌套值也不可被外部修改。`config` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物。
按 `sources` 数组的顺序（后者覆盖前者）合并多个已拥有的配置根。只有一个来源且未提供任何合并选项时，直接返回该来源，保留根 identity；其他情形产出新的 owned 配置。全部来源必须共享同一个 `profile`，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`。
`strategies` 是全局默认策略；`pathRules` 是一组 `{ prefix, strategies }`，按 `prefix`（从根开始的键路径）匹配当前正在合并的键路径，`prefix` 更长（更具体）的规则优先生效，命中的规则会与全局 `strategies` 合并（规则内声明的字段覆盖全局同名字段，规则未声明的字段沿用全局值）。
每次 `combineConfig` 调用会在合并来源前读取每条规则的 `prefix` 和 `strategies` 一次并建立索引；相同前缀以输入中最先声明的规则为准。规则描述必须稳定：不支持依赖 getter 每次返回不同描述，或在合并过程中修改规则来影响后续属性。

当某个键在双方都存在、且不属于以上任何自动合并分支（例如两侧都是不可合并的原始值）时，若提供了 `onConflict`，会调用它并传入 `IConfigConflictContext`（`path`：当前键的完整路径；`left`：左侧/已有值；`right`：右侧/新值），其返回值 `IConfigConflictDecision` 决定最终结果：`{ kind: 'left' }` 保留左值、`{ kind: 'right' }` 采用右值、`{ kind: 'delete' }` 删除该键、`{ kind: 'value', value }` 采用自定义值。`onConflict` 必须同步返回（返回 Promise 会抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`；返回值不是上述四种 `kind` 之一同样抛 `CONFIG_CONFLICT`）。未提供 `onConflict` 时右侧直接覆盖左侧（标准合并语义）。`right === CONFIG_DELETE` 会删除目标键（可用于合并阶段裁剪掉某个来源写入的默认值）。

数组采用 concat 或 mergeByIndex 时，同一次合并使用私有累计数组；`onConflict` 当场读取当前累计内容，保留的引用会随后续合并更新。回调只读取累计值并返回决策；直接修改累计数组（包括写入、delete、修改 length 或 freeze）属于不支持的用法。需要替换时返回 `{ kind: 'value', value }`。实现不为直接修改增加运行时检查或拒绝逻辑。

`ConfigOwner` 持有一份不可变的配置快照，把 `ownConfig` / `readConfigPath` / `patchConfig` / `combineConfig` / `readonlyConfig` 集中到一个可链式调用的类上。每次写入都会先完整构建并校验下一份快照，再提交；失败时旧快照不变。路径类型由 `IObjectPath` 推导，`get('server.port')` 的类型就是 `number | undefined`。

items: 读取：`get` / `getOr` / `require` / `read` / `has` / `view()`（深只读视图）/ `select(path)`（子树的新 owner）/ `diff` / `equals`。
写入（返回 `this`）：`set` / `delete` / `patch` / `combine` / `batch(fn)`（一次校验、一次通知，失败整体回滚）/ `reset()` / `lock()`。
监听：`watch(listener)` 或 `watch(path, listener)`；监听器异常交给 `report`（默认进入宿主未捕获错误队列），监听器内再写入会抛 `REENTRANT_CALL`。
序列化：`toJSON()` / `toString(space)`；Map、Set、函数等非 JSON 值抛 `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`。
静态：`from`、`fromAsync`（Promise、值或接收 `signal` 的工厂；支持 `signal` / `timeoutMs`）、`fromEnv`、`merge`、`is`。与 `@migaia/resource` 的 `createResource` 组合即可得到一份响应式的配置资源。

blocks.text: `diff` 按左侧自身字符串键优先、再追加右侧独有键的顺序，深度优先比较数据。每对对象只访问一次；共享分支的同一差异只出现在首次到达的路径上，不再为其他别名重复报告。循环上没有数据差异时，`equals` 返回 `true`。路径监听使用同样的数据比较规则；监听顺序、取消订阅和异常上报规则不变。

blocks.text: 错误上的 `source` 表示来源，`code` 表示这个来源内的失败种类。 本包稳定领域为 `UTILS_SOURCE === 'foundation.utils'`，npm 导入仍使用 `@migaia/utils` 及其公开子路径。`UtilsErrorCode` 的键与值如下；原生 `TypeError`、`RangeError` 等加码后仍保留原类型，不能只看消息文本。

items: `invalidArgument` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT`：参数类型或范围不合法，修正参数后再调用。
`nonErrorValue` / `NON_ERROR_VALUE`：`toError()` 包装了非错误的抛出值，原值在 `cause`。
`envUnsupported` / `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`：宿主缺少必要能力，换用支持它的环境或注入实现。
`aborted` / `ABORTED`：操作收到协作式取消，原取消原因在错误链上。
`deadlineExceeded` / `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`：操作、单次尝试或总流程超时；检查 `scope` 与 `timeoutMs` 再决定是否重试。
`schedulerRunaway` / `SCHEDULER_RUNAWAY`：虚拟时钟一次推进执行超过 10000 个回调，检查同一时刻不断排入任务的循环。
`errorIdentityConflict` / `ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT`：已有身份与新字段冲突，保留原错误身份，由调用方选择冲突策略。
`errorChainInvalid` / `ERROR_CHAIN_INVALID`：序列化错误树不符合字段、深度、数量或字节约束，修正边界输入。
`cloneUnsupported` / `CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`：结构化克隆拒绝该值，先转换为可克隆数据。
`invalidEncoding` / `INVALID_ENCODING`：字节或文本编码输入不合法，根据错误中的位置修正输入。
`limiterClosed` / `LIMITER_CLOSED`：关闭后的并发限制器拒绝新任务，需要创建新限制器。
`reentrantCall` / `REENTRANT_CALL`：不允许重入的操作在自身执行期间再次被调用，把嵌套调用移出当前执行过程。
`configUnsupported` / `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`：配置的根、字段或值不在支持范围内，按所选配置档位提供数据。
`configReadonly` / `CONFIG_READONLY`：尝试修改只读配置，改用补丁或合并生成下一份配置。
`configConflict` / `CONFIG_CONFLICT`：配置来源、档位或所有权不一致，先统一来源约束。
`configLimitExceeded` / `CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`：配置图超过上限，或上限选项不合法，缩小输入并检查限制设置。
`configPathInvalid` / `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`：配置路径格式或键名不安全，修正路径。
`configParseFailed` / `CONFIG_PARSE_FAILED`：`ConfigOwner.from()` 收到非字符串或非法 JSON，原解析错误保留在 `cause`。
`configSourceFailed` / `CONFIG_SOURCE_FAILED`：`ConfigOwner.fromAsync()` 的来源失败，原拒绝保留在 `cause`，由调用方选择重试或默认配置。
`configValueMissing` / `CONFIG_VALUE_MISSING`：`ConfigOwner.require()` 没找到路径值，补充配置或用 `getOr()` 明确提供默认值。
`configValidationFailed` / `CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED`：校验器拒绝下一份配置，上一份保持不变，校验错误保留在 `cause`。
`objectPathInvalid` / `OBJECT_PATH_INVALID`：对象路径或其中一段不合法，修正路径输入。
`formatInvalid` / `FORMAT_INVALID`：模板语法或插值不合法，检查模板与值。
`formatValueMissing` / `FORMAT_VALUE_MISSING`：严格模板模式缺少占位符的值，补充对应数据。
`numberFormatInvalid` / `NUMBER_FORMAT_INVALID`：`Intl.NumberFormat` 拒绝地区、货币、选项或数值，修正格式化参数。

symbols.name: IPathAccessorOptions
symbols.purpose: Hooks of `createPathAccessor()`.
symbols.core:
ifMissing: Called when a read finds a missing segment.
Not set: missing reads just return `undefined`.
Use this hook to record absent path segments. It cannot supply a replacement; a missing read still returns undefined. Omission sends no notification.
ifBlocked: Called when a read meets a non-object on the way.
Not set.
Use this hook to distinguish a null or primitive parent from a missing property. The read still returns undefined; omission sends no notification.
ifFailed: Called when a getter throws during a read.
Not set: the error is not reported.
Use this hook to record a getter or proxy failure at its path. Returning normally still rethrows the original error; omission only removes the notification.
onGet: Called after each successful `get`; `event.replace(value)` changes the returned value.
Use event.replace to change the value presented by successful reads without changing stored data. Omission returns the stored value unchanged; a thrown hook error propagates.
onSet: Called before each `set` is applied; `event.replace(value)` changes the written value.
Use event.replace to normalize incoming values before a write. Omission stores the supplied value unchanged; a thrown hook error stops the write.
symbols.advanced: Keep a typed read policy that trims a display name whenever a path accessor reads it.

blocks.text: 带所有权语义的配置对象：只有经 `ownConfig` 接纳的对象才能被 `readonlyConfig`/`patchConfig`/`readConfigPath`/`combineConfig` 处理，用运行时 `WeakMap` 元数据（而非可伪造的字段）标记"这是一个受本包管理的配置根"。

blocks.code:
const ConfigProfile = { data: 'data', richRuntime: 'richRuntime' } as const
type IConfigProfile = 'data' | 'richRuntime'

blocks.text: `data`（默认）：只接受可移植的纯数据——普通对象、数组、`Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 等内置类型；拒绝函数。`richRuntime`：额外接受函数/可构造类（连同其自身属性与 `prototype` 一起深拷贝），用于确实需要在配置里携带回调或工厂的场景。

blocks.code: const CONFIG_DELETE: unique symbol

blocks.text: 在 `patchConfig`/`combineConfig` 的补丁对象中，把某个键的值设为这个符号，表示"删除该键"（而不是设为 `undefined`）。
深拷贝 `value` 得到一个独立的、被本包元数据标记为"已拥有"的图。要求根必须是普通对象（不能是数组）且不含 `symbol` 键。深拷贝过程中：

items: `Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 会被识别并对应构造新实例（而不是被当成普通对象递归展开字段）；
循环引用通过内部 `WeakMap` 保留同一图结构（不会无限递归，也不会拆散共享节点）；
`__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 键一律拒绝；
超过 `limits`（见下）中的深度/节点数/键数会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'` 的 `RangeError`。

blocks.text: 若 `value` 已经是某次 `ownConfig` 的返回值（元数据匹配同一 `profile`/`limits`），直接原样返回（幂等）；若元数据不匹配（例如同一对象先后用不同 `profile` 调用），抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'` 的 `TypeError`。

调用方拿到结果后有三种明确路径：内部继续把它作为稳定配置根；通过 `readonlyConfig()` 暴露可读但不可写的递归 Proxy；通过 `patchConfig()` 或 `combineConfig()` 派生下一份已拥有配置。不要直接把原始外部对象交给这些 API，也不要把“已拥有”误解为冻结——所有权保证来自独立图与内部登记，运行时写保护由 `readonlyConfig()` 单独提供。

blocks.code:
type IConfigLimits = {
  readonly maxDepth: number // 默认 256
  readonly maxNodes: number // 默认 100_000
  readonly maxKeys: number // 默认 1_000_000
  readonly maxPathLength: number // 默认 4096
  readonly maxSegmentLength: number // 默认 512
}

blocks.text: `limits` 不得超过包级默认上限。`patchConfig` 相对输入基准只能收紧，放宽会抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT；`combineConfig` 取所有输入与请求上限的逐项最小值，放宽请求被自动收紧，不因此抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT。

blocks.code: function readonlyConfig<T extends IConfigRecord>(value: IOwnedConfig<T>): T

blocks.text: 返回一个带缓存的只读对象，内部通过 `Proxy` 拦截修改；同一输入对象重复调用会返回同一个只读对象。读取时仍然访问原配置，没有再复制一份数据。任何写操作（`set`/`defineProperty`/`deleteProperty`/`setPrototypeOf`/`preventExtensions`，以及 `Map`/`Set`/`Date` 上的变更方法如 `.set()`/`.add()`/`.setFullYear()`）都会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_READONLY'` 的 `TypeError`。嵌套对象、`Map`、`Set` 和函数字段也会受到同样的写入保护。`value` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`。

对根做写时复制式覆盖：`patch` 中每个键要么设为新值（会被递归深拷贝并纳入所有权），要么设为 `CONFIG_DELETE` 表示删除。只有被改动路径上的节点被复制，未涉及的子树按引用共享。`patch` 为空对象且 `reuseUnchangedRoot`（默认 `true`）时直接返回 `base` 本身，不做任何拷贝。`patch` 必须是普通对象、键不能是 `symbol`、不能是访问器属性，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`；键名撞上 `__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 抛 `code: 'CONFIG_PATH_INVALID'`。注意：`patchConfig` 只在根一层应用补丁——要修改嵌套字段，先用 `get`/`set`（`/object` 模块）在应用层算出新的嵌套子树，再作为整体值放进 `patch`。
在 `/object` 模块的 `parseObjectPath` 基础上叠加 config 专属限制（长度上限可自定义，默认取包级默认值）并强制所有段都是字符串（不支持数字下标简写形式在 config 路径里独立出现，统一按字符串段处理）。
读取配置内某条路径，区分"键不存在"（`missing`）与"值就是 `undefined`"（`value: undefined`）。返回的对象/函数类型的值会自动包一层只读 Proxy（与 `readonlyConfig` 相同的包装逻辑），保证读到的嵌套值也不可被外部修改。`config` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物。
按 `sources` 数组的顺序（后者覆盖前者）合并多个已拥有的配置根。只有一个来源且未提供任何合并选项时，直接返回该来源，保留根 identity；其他情形产出新的 owned 配置。全部来源必须共享同一个 `profile`，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`。
`strategies` 是全局默认策略；`pathRules` 是一组 `{ prefix, strategies }`，按 `prefix`（从根开始的键路径）匹配当前正在合并的键路径，`prefix` 更长（更具体）的规则优先生效，命中的规则会与全局 `strategies` 合并（规则内声明的字段覆盖全局同名字段，规则未声明的字段沿用全局值）。
每次 `combineConfig` 调用会在合并来源前读取每条规则的 `prefix` 和 `strategies` 一次并建立索引；相同前缀以输入中最先声明的规则为准。规则描述必须稳定：不支持依赖 getter 每次返回不同描述，或在合并过程中修改规则来影响后续属性。

当某个键在双方都存在、且不属于以上任何自动合并分支（例如两侧都是不可合并的原始值）时，若提供了 `onConflict`，会调用它并传入 `IConfigConflictContext`（`path`：当前键的完整路径；`left`：左侧/已有值；`right`：右侧/新值），其返回值 `IConfigConflictDecision` 决定最终结果：`{ kind: 'left' }` 保留左值、`{ kind: 'right' }` 采用右值、`{ kind: 'delete' }` 删除该键、`{ kind: 'value', value }` 采用自定义值。`onConflict` 必须同步返回（返回 Promise 会抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`；返回值不是上述四种 `kind` 之一同样抛 `CONFIG_CONFLICT`）。未提供 `onConflict` 时右侧直接覆盖左侧（标准合并语义）。`right === CONFIG_DELETE` 会删除目标键（可用于合并阶段裁剪掉某个来源写入的默认值）。

数组采用 concat 或 mergeByIndex 时，同一次合并使用私有累计数组；`onConflict` 当场读取当前累计内容，保留的引用会随后续合并更新。回调只读取累计值并返回决策；直接修改累计数组（包括写入、delete、修改 length 或 freeze）属于不支持的用法。需要替换时返回 `{ kind: 'value', value }`。实现不为直接修改增加运行时检查或拒绝逻辑。

guidance.id: 错误被包装后-仍能认出底层原因
guidance.heading: 错误被包装后，仍能认出底层原因

blocks.text: 底层的断线错误被一层层包装成“加载订单失败”，上层想知道是不是断线，只能比较 message 文本。
比较 message 很脆弱：文案一改，判断就失效；替换错误对象又会丢掉原来的类型和堆栈。
`attachErrorIdentity` 把稳定的 `source` 和 `code` 直接写到原错误上，不替换错误对象，`instanceof` 和堆栈都不变；`walkErrorCauses` 沿着 `cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors` 把它找出来。
输出：

blocks.code:
加载订单失败 | 底层是断线吗: true
原始错误仍是 Error 实例: true

blocks.text: 输出 `加载订单失败 | 底层是断线吗: true`：外层 message 是业务文案，判断依据的是 code。
`原始错误仍是 Error 实例: true`：附加身份没有改变原错误的类型。
带所有权语义的配置对象：只有经 `ownConfig` 接纳的对象才能被 `readonlyConfig`/`patchConfig`/`readConfigPath`/`combineConfig` 处理，用运行时 `WeakMap` 元数据（而非可伪造的字段）标记"这是一个受本包管理的配置根"。

blocks.code:
const ConfigProfile = { data: 'data', richRuntime: 'richRuntime' } as const
type IConfigProfile = 'data' | 'richRuntime'

blocks.text: `data`（默认）：只接受可移植的纯数据——普通对象、数组、`Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 等内置类型；拒绝函数。`richRuntime`：额外接受函数/可构造类（连同其自身属性与 `prototype` 一起深拷贝），用于确实需要在配置里携带回调或工厂的场景。

blocks.code: const CONFIG_DELETE: unique symbol

blocks.text: 在 `patchConfig`/`combineConfig` 的补丁对象中，把某个键的值设为这个符号，表示"删除该键"（而不是设为 `undefined`）。
深拷贝 `value` 得到一个独立的、被本包元数据标记为"已拥有"的图。要求根必须是普通对象（不能是数组）且不含 `symbol` 键。深拷贝过程中：

items: `Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 会被识别并对应构造新实例（而不是被当成普通对象递归展开字段）；
循环引用通过内部 `WeakMap` 保留同一图结构（不会无限递归，也不会拆散共享节点）；
`__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 键一律拒绝；
超过 `limits`（见下）中的深度/节点数/键数会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'` 的 `RangeError`。

blocks.text: 若 `value` 已经是某次 `ownConfig` 的返回值（元数据匹配同一 `profile`/`limits`），直接原样返回（幂等）；若元数据不匹配（例如同一对象先后用不同 `profile` 调用），抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'` 的 `TypeError`。

调用方拿到结果后有三种明确路径：内部继续把它作为稳定配置根；通过 `readonlyConfig()` 暴露可读但不可写的递归 Proxy；通过 `patchConfig()` 或 `combineConfig()` 派生下一份已拥有配置。不要直接把原始外部对象交给这些 API，也不要把“已拥有”误解为冻结——所有权保证来自独立图与内部登记，运行时写保护由 `readonlyConfig()` 单独提供。

blocks.code:
type IConfigLimits = {
  readonly maxDepth: number // 默认 256
  readonly maxNodes: number // 默认 100_000
  readonly maxKeys: number // 默认 1_000_000
  readonly maxPathLength: number // 默认 4096
  readonly maxSegmentLength: number // 默认 512
}

blocks.text: `limits` 不得超过包级默认上限。`patchConfig` 相对输入基准只能收紧，放宽会抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT；`combineConfig` 取所有输入与请求上限的逐项最小值，放宽请求被自动收紧，不因此抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT。

blocks.code: function readonlyConfig<T extends IConfigRecord>(value: IOwnedConfig<T>): T

blocks.text: 返回一个带缓存的只读对象，内部通过 `Proxy` 拦截修改；同一输入对象重复调用会返回同一个只读对象。读取时仍然访问原配置，没有再复制一份数据。任何写操作（`set`/`defineProperty`/`deleteProperty`/`setPrototypeOf`/`preventExtensions`，以及 `Map`/`Set`/`Date` 上的变更方法如 `.set()`/`.add()`/`.setFullYear()`）都会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_READONLY'` 的 `TypeError`。嵌套对象、`Map`、`Set` 和函数字段也会受到同样的写入保护。`value` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`。

对根做写时复制式覆盖：`patch` 中每个键要么设为新值（会被递归深拷贝并纳入所有权），要么设为 `CONFIG_DELETE` 表示删除。只有被改动路径上的节点被复制，未涉及的子树按引用共享。`patch` 为空对象且 `reuseUnchangedRoot`（默认 `true`）时直接返回 `base` 本身，不做任何拷贝。`patch` 必须是普通对象、键不能是 `symbol`、不能是访问器属性，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`；键名撞上 `__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 抛 `code: 'CONFIG_PATH_INVALID'`。注意：`patchConfig` 只在根一层应用补丁——要修改嵌套字段，先用 `get`/`set`（`/object` 模块）在应用层算出新的嵌套子树，再作为整体值放进 `patch`。
在 `/object` 模块的 `parseObjectPath` 基础上叠加 config 专属限制（长度上限可自定义，默认取包级默认值）并强制所有段都是字符串（不支持数字下标简写形式在 config 路径里独立出现，统一按字符串段处理）。
读取配置内某条路径，区分"键不存在"（`missing`）与"值就是 `undefined`"（`value: undefined`）。返回的对象/函数类型的值会自动包一层只读 Proxy（与 `readonlyConfig` 相同的包装逻辑），保证读到的嵌套值也不可被外部修改。`config` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物。
按 `sources` 数组的顺序（后者覆盖前者）合并多个已拥有的配置根。只有一个来源且未提供任何合并选项时，直接返回该来源，保留根 identity；其他情形产出新的 owned 配置。全部来源必须共享同一个 `profile`，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`。
`strategies` 是全局默认策略；`pathRules` 是一组 `{ prefix, strategies }`，按 `prefix`（从根开始的键路径）匹配当前正在合并的键路径，`prefix` 更长（更具体）的规则优先生效，命中的规则会与全局 `strategies` 合并（规则内声明的字段覆盖全局同名字段，规则未声明的字段沿用全局值）。
每次 `combineConfig` 调用会在合并来源前读取每条规则的 `prefix` 和 `strategies` 一次并建立索引；相同前缀以输入中最先声明的规则为准。规则描述必须稳定：不支持依赖 getter 每次返回不同描述，或在合并过程中修改规则来影响后续属性。

当某个键在双方都存在、且不属于以上任何自动合并分支（例如两侧都是不可合并的原始值）时，若提供了 `onConflict`，会调用它并传入 `IConfigConflictContext`（`path`：当前键的完整路径；`left`：左侧/已有值；`right`：右侧/新值），其返回值 `IConfigConflictDecision` 决定最终结果：`{ kind: 'left' }` 保留左值、`{ kind: 'right' }` 采用右值、`{ kind: 'delete' }` 删除该键、`{ kind: 'value', value }` 采用自定义值。`onConflict` 必须同步返回（返回 Promise 会抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`；返回值不是上述四种 `kind` 之一同样抛 `CONFIG_CONFLICT`）。未提供 `onConflict` 时右侧直接覆盖左侧（标准合并语义）。`right === CONFIG_DELETE` 会删除目标键（可用于合并阶段裁剪掉某个来源写入的默认值）。

数组采用 concat 或 mergeByIndex 时，同一次合并使用私有累计数组；`onConflict` 当场读取当前累计内容，保留的引用会随后续合并更新。回调只读取累计值并返回决策；直接修改累计数组（包括写入、delete、修改 length 或 freeze）属于不支持的用法。需要替换时返回 `{ kind: 'value', value }`。实现不为直接修改增加运行时检查或拒绝逻辑。

`ConfigOwner` 持有一份不可变的配置快照，把 `ownConfig` / `readConfigPath` / `patchConfig` / `combineConfig` / `readonlyConfig` 集中到一个可链式调用的类上。每次写入都会先完整构建并校验下一份快照，再提交；失败时旧快照不变。路径类型由 `IObjectPath` 推导，`get('server.port')` 的类型就是 `number | undefined`。

items: 读取：`get` / `getOr` / `require` / `read` / `has` / `view()`（深只读视图）/ `select(path)`（子树的新 owner）/ `diff` / `equals`。
写入（返回 `this`）：`set` / `delete` / `patch` / `combine` / `batch(fn)`（一次校验、一次通知，失败整体回滚）/ `reset()` / `lock()`。
监听：`watch(listener)` 或 `watch(path, listener)`；监听器异常交给 `report`（默认进入宿主未捕获错误队列），监听器内再写入会抛 `REENTRANT_CALL`。
序列化：`toJSON()` / `toString(space)`；Map、Set、函数等非 JSON 值抛 `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`。
静态：`from`、`fromAsync`（Promise、值或接收 `signal` 的工厂；支持 `signal` / `timeoutMs`）、`fromEnv`、`merge`、`is`。与 `@migaia/resource` 的 `createResource` 组合即可得到一份响应式的配置资源。

blocks.text: `diff` 按左侧自身字符串键优先、再追加右侧独有键的顺序，深度优先比较数据。每对对象只访问一次；共享分支的同一差异只出现在首次到达的路径上，不再为其他别名重复报告。循环上没有数据差异时，`equals` 返回 `true`。路径监听使用同样的数据比较规则；监听顺序、取消订阅和异常上报规则不变。

guidance.id: config-先接纳配置-再公开读取和派生新配置
guidance.heading: /config：先接纳配置，再公开读取和派生新配置

blocks.text: `ownConfig` 是接收外部配置的边界：复制输入并登记独立、可验证所有权。`WeakMap` 是不往配置上添加字段的元数据表，库用它保留 `profile` 与 `limits`；普通对象不能通过伪造字段变成已接纳的配置。默认 `data` 档位接纳数据，`richRuntime` 还允许回调或工厂。

`ownConfig` 返回对象没有被冻结；获得所有权和公开只读访问是两件事。`readonlyConfig` 给已有配置套上只读保护，正常读取仍访问原数据，没有复制第二份配置，不允许调用方修改任何层级。`Map.set()`、`Set.add()`、`Date.setFullYear()` 等修改方法都会报错。公开读取用它，更新用 `patchConfig()` 生成下一份受管理配置，不是写 `view`；需要区分路径缺失与值为 `undefined` 时用 `readConfigPath`。补丁只作用于根字段，嵌套修改先算出新子树，再整体放入补丁。携带函数的 `richRuntime` 是运行时配置，不应当作可序列化数据。
`combineConfig` 按输入顺序合并，后面的来源覆盖前面；对象默认递归合并，数组默认替换。下面明确改用数组拼接，展示两个输入、结果与调用方自己整理的变化记录。
`defaults` 与 `override` 没有被修改。这里的 `diff` 只是把结果变化写明，不是 `combineConfig` 的额外返回值。
需要持有快照并比较变化时，用 `ConfigOwner.diff(other)` / `equals(other)`。对比按左侧键优先、深度优先的固定顺序遍历，每对对象只比较一次；共享节点的同一差异只报告首次到达的路径，不再为每条别名重复输出。没有数据差异的循环引用视为相等。

blocks.text: 创建一个可交给多个底层请求共享的 operation signal，但不创建、race 或结算业务 Promise。外部 signal 先中止时保留原始 reason；deadline 先到时使用 `timeoutReason()` 的返回值。reason factory 抛出的原始错误会成为 signal reason，不会从 timer callback 逃逸。无 `timeoutMs` 时透传外部 signal identity；`dispose()` 幂等并负责取消 timer、移除 listener，cleanup 失败通过 `report` 的 `operation: 'abort-timeout-signal'` 上报。

`withTimeout` / `raceWithAbort` 的 callback 也能把同一 cooperative signal 交给多个请求，但它们同时拥有最终 Promise 的超时/中止 reject、late rejection 与 cleanup-error 政策。若事务 commit 才是唯一结算事实，应使用本 signal-only primitive，并由适配器自己决定 Promise 何时完成。

symbols.purpose: Creates a gate that runs at most `concurrency` tasks at once; extra tasks wait in FIFO order and can be cancelled while queued.

options: `concurrency` (required, positive safe integer): maximum running tasks. `report` (optional): receives late failures; default `hostRethrowReporter`.
An `IConcurrencyLimiter`.

blocks.text: 本包中唯一具有跨调用生命周期的原语——一个带并发上限的 FIFO 任务队列：

items: `run(task, { signal })`：把任务加入队列，达到 `concurrency` 上限前的任务立即执行，之后排队等待空位；传入的 `signal` 中止会让排队中的任务立即以其中止原因 reject（已开始执行的任务不受影响，需任务自身读取 `context.signal`）。
`activeCount` / `pendingCount`：当前正在执行 / 排队等待（未取消）的任务数。
`whenIdle()`：返回一个在"当前没有活跃任务且队列已清空"时 resolve 的 Promise；多次调用共享同一个等待，不会重复注册。
`close(reason?)`：停止接纳新任务与排队任务——已排队但未执行的任务立即以 `reason`（默认一个 `LIMITER_CLOSED` 错误）reject；正在执行的任务不受影响。
`dispose(reason?)`：调用 `close()` 并返回一个在所有活跃任务结束后才 resolve 的 Promise，用于优雅关闭。

blocks.text: `concurrency` 必须是正安全整数，否则构造时抛 `RangeError`。
